economy.zh:
过去24小时，全球市场在多重冲击下剧烈波动。美国新关税生效即遭起诉，特朗普同时威胁对欧盟加征“实质性关税”，叠加伊朗战争推高油价至100美元/桶，美股科技板块承压，特斯拉单周暴跌18%。欧洲央行维持利率不变但鹰派信号明确，市场押注9月加息，欧元区企业提价困难。中国方面，Trip.com遭反垄断重罚5.2亿元，证监会原副主席方星海被查，但港股在改革和ETF资金流入下强势反弹。同花顺社区热议监管风暴与资金流向。整体来看，贸易摩擦、能源危机与政策不确定性构成当前市场主线。

- **特朗普关税战升级**：新关税生效数小时后即被起诉，专家质疑其法律基础；同时特朗普威胁对欧盟征收“实质性关税”，指控欧盟“抢劫”美国科技巨头。[Trump sued hours after new tariffs take effect](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/trump-tariffs-lawsuit-301-ieepa.html) ｜ [Trump threatens EU with 'substantial TARIFF'](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/trump-tariffs-eu-trade-google-apple-tech.html)
- **特斯拉遭遇2022年以来最差单周**：财报不及预期、现金流转负，股价周跌幅近18%，马斯克“糟糕的一周”还包括SpaceX IPO后首次星舰试飞前股价下跌。[Musk's bad week: Tesla suffers worst slump](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/tesla-tsla-spcx-stock-starship-test-flight-musk-bad-week.html)
- **债券市场对AI资本支出感到焦虑**：谷歌、亚马逊、Meta信用利差走阔，固定收益投资者要求更高回报，质疑巨额AI投入的回报前景。[Bond market anxiety is growing over AI capex](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/bond-market-anxiety-ai-capex-spending.html)
- **欧洲央行维持利率不变但偏鹰**：能源价格高企强化9月加息预期，欧元区企业调查显示提价困难，消费者通胀预期仍待观察。[ECB Keeps Tightening Bias as Energy Prices Strengthen Case for September Hike](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxNNTZqb3ZJRTZVN3JfYmwwVlExTUJNOGwwOE5xUUNsWEl2U1pFQzNqYmFYRjF2Wk53d3p1NHJlR3NyZUlXTFNnT3JLdTVLbUpuR3VCdThUMkREdmlrY1I2VWpOWTJjQkx3Rnd2QVlWRFlhNE96eUFhVE1HN0xaTTZxZGdOQmZaUXZwZjBmWElZZmp5VXpxYmROODZ2aVVNY3FocXJrTG5ZSQ)
- **中国反垄断重拳出击**：Trip.com因滥用市场支配地位被罚7.65亿美元，为在线旅游领域最大罚单；同时证监会原副主席方星海被调查，释放强监管信号。[China hits Trip.com with US$765 million antitrust penalty](https://www.scmp.com/tech/policy/article/3361818/china-hits-tripcom-us765-million-antitrust-penalty-after-six-month-investigation) ｜ [China places former deputy of top financial regulator under investigation](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3361782/china-places-former-deputy-top-financial-regulator-under-investigation)
- **宁德时代创纪录季度利润**：二季度营收1477.9亿元、净利润225亿元均创历史新高，但电动车需求放缓拖累部分预期，公司同步宣布A股史上最大单次回购。[CATL posts record quarterly profits](https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/3361795/chinese-battery-giant-catl-posts-record-quarterly-profits-amid-green-energy-boom) ｜ [宁德时代回应发起A股史上最大单次回购](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE1rejJkVndhRHBHdXo1REpuM05ldk51NzRocGQ4RnhBQnZRcWF0SDFPTXg0NUxIMUcxS1FkUDFVOWhQa1RTQXNwbFNxSThPd3RZa2Fz)
- **港股迎来八年最大改革**：香港交易所允许所有上市申请保密提交，降低初创及国际公司市值门槛，旨在吸引更多IPO。[Hong Kong exchange’s biggest reform in 8 years opens gates to more IPOs](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3361742/hong-kong-exchanges-biggest-reform-8-years-opens-gates-more-ipos)
- **资金动向：宽基ETF单周净流入超500亿元**，7月24日单日ETF净流入205.77亿元，显示机构资金在市场震荡中加速布局。[本周宽基ETF净流入超500亿](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE52NUg4UnY1aFBWcUhCcXNVZHoxWHpVdFk3X0xuNlNVeVFRSXNtTmtJSWtEMU96WWtLWm1mWFFmN3JxZUNtcXJ2QVR4VHA5ek44clZvWGR6RThMVTJ4clE)

**后续观察**：下周需重点关注：1）美国对欧盟关税威胁的后续进展及欧盟反制措施；2）特斯拉财报后的市场情绪修复，以及SpaceX星舰试飞结果对母公司估值的影响；3）中国监管风暴是否扩大到更多科技平台；4）欧洲PMI数据公布后对欧元走势的指引。地缘政治（海湾战争）与货币政策（鹰派联储&欧央行）的交叉影响将持续主导风险资产定价。
economy.en:
Global markets are navigating a complex landscape shaped by renewed US tariffs, an oil price spike tied to Middle East tensions, and diverging central bank stances. The ECB held rates steady but maintained a hawkish bias, while bond markets grow anxious over AI capex budgets. In China, regulators imposed a landmark antitrust fine on Trip.com, while HKEX unveiled major listing reforms. The week also saw Tesla's worst slump since 2022 and SpaceX's first Starship test flight post-IPO. Below are the key developments across desks.

- **Tariffs Escalate & Oil Shock:** President Trump imposed new 25% tariffs on Brazilian imports and threatened 50% on Canadian goods, sparking an immediate lawsuit. Separately, Trump threatened the EU with 'substantial tariff' over tech fines. Combined with a Persian Gulf war pushing oil past $100/barrel, the global economy faces a stagflationary jolt ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/trump-tariffs-lawsuit-301-ieepa.html), [NYT](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/25/business/economy/trump-tariffs-iran-war-inflation.html)).
- **ECB Holds Firm, September Hike Priced In:** The ECB kept rates unchanged but signaled a tightening bias amid rising energy prices. Traders now see a September hike as likely, while the euro strengthened as the dollar also gained on safe-haven flows ([FOREX.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxNNTZqb3ZJRTZVN3JfYmwwVlExTUJNOGwwOE5xUUNsWEl2U1pFQzNqYmFYRjF2Wk53d3p1NHJlR3NyZUlXTFNnT3JLdTVLbUpuR3VCdThUMkREdmlrY1I2VWpOWTJjQkx3Rnd2QVlWRFlhNE96eUFhVE1HN0xaTTZxZGdOQmZaUXZwZjBmWElZZmp5VXpxYmROODZ2aVVNY3FocXJrTG5ZSQ), [Moomoo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxNWklWRlRFaHFhSmJOMkdFOTIwZFNYLTZTQ2xiM2NVQ2NEamx0RXNxN0RSaTdGenR1S1dRQjliV1hjUl9PLXFrZVBWaEljTGVYd2xyU1VkTThUeGM0bm9HdGZvTWttUlE4T1hYSWlYQ2g2SlZ2UDFWU01jODl1d21qa2ROYVJmU2NIdnl2Z2ZxbWttSHRpT3VyQnNHcVg1Zw)).
- **Bond Market Anxious Over AI Capex:** Credit spreads on Google, Amazon, and Meta are widening as fixed-income investors demand higher rewards for lending to companies with massive AI spending plans ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/bond-market-anxiety-ai-capex-spending.html)).
- **Tesla Plunges, SpaceX Test Flight:** Tesla shares fell nearly 18% on earnings miss and negative cash flow, while SpaceX launched its Starship rocket in its first test flight since last month's IPO – a pivotal moment for Musk's empire ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/tesla-tsla-spcx-stock-starship-test-flight-musk-bad-week.html), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/spacex-launches-massive-starship-rocket-in-first-test-flight-since-ipo.html)).
- **China Fines Trip.com $765M, HKEX Reforms:** China's market regulator hit Trip.com with a record antitrust penalty for monopolistic conduct. Meanwhile, HKEX announced its biggest listing reforms in 8 years, allowing confidential filings and lowering thresholds for startups ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/tech/policy/article/3361818/china-hits-tripcom-us765-million-antitrust-penalty-after-six-month-investigation), [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3361742/hong-kong-exchanges-biggest-reform-8-years-opens-gates-more-ipos)).
- **Record CATL Profit but EV Demand Soft:** CATL posted record quarterly revenue and profit, but still missed estimates as China's EV demand weakened, highlighting a mixed outlook for the battery giant ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/3361795/chinese-battery-giant-catl-posts-record-quarterly-profits-amid-green-energy-boom)).
- **Community Buzz: ETF Inflows & Watchdog Probe:** Chinese retail investors noted over 500 billion yuan in weekly ETF inflows and the investigation of former CSRC vice-chair Fang Xinghai, signaling continued state intervention in markets ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE52NUg4UnY1aFBWcUhCcXNVZHoxWHpVdFk3X0xuNlNVeVFRSXNtTmtJSWtEMU96WWtLWm1mWFFmN3JxZUNtcXJ2QVR4VHA5ek44clZvWGR6RThMVTJ4clE), [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9ySHFJbkpoaXJOQnBaTlFwb0Y0U2hHbUhPNWVBMkx2Q0Q2aWNCcElUbHJlV050Y0NWd3hEWHpGYkZ2NnBrc1JTQnpJclhyUFptMHR3dnBxRENIUWFlR1E)).

**Watch next:** All eyes are on the Federal Reserve's task force announcement on monetary policy conduct, and the outcome of Trump's tariff lawsuits. In Europe, the ECB's September decision will be heavily influenced by oil prices and PMI data due next week. China's antitrust actions and HKEX reform implementation will be key for market sentiment in Asia.

society.zh:
今日全球社会新闻呈现两条主线：地缘冲突持续升温与国内社会治理议题交织。美伊在波斯湾互相打击，中东紧张推高全球油价；俄乌战场无人机展遭袭，乌防长被撤引发政治危机。同时，欧洲野火迫使超22万人撤离，彰显气候危机紧迫。国内方面，中国基础教育成就与菲尔兹奖得主热议形成对照，知乎社区则因营收下滑与AI转型引发讨论。

- **[美伊在波斯湾互相打击，紧张局势升级](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c05ql5llj4do)**：伊朗谴责美国计划用冻结资产支付战争赔款，特朗普称“已锁定目标”并寻求谈判，但冲突风险持续升高。
- **[俄军导弹袭击基辅附近无人机展，10人死亡](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cj637zd1k1ko)**：乌克兰国防工业重要人物出席，事件暴露战时集会安全脆弱性。泽连斯基因[解除国防部长职务](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1d1gz3n99ro)引发持续抗议，政治压力加大。
- **[法西野火肆虐，超22万人撤离](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/czjlenp0xk8o)**：波尔多附近火势蔓延，马德里称遭遇“史上最严重火灾”，气候变化影响愈发直接。
- **[特朗普出席白宫记者协会晚宴](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cd7le4ylev2o)**：调侃媒体，强调新闻自由，晚宴因4月枪击事件推迟。同日他又[命令史密森尼博物馆标注“不准确”历史](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1w10gwnj74o)，持续争夺叙事权。
- **[国际刑事法院首席检察官因性行为不端被免职](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cqjxddx12qqo)**：卡里姆·汗否认指控，但事件动摇ICC公信力。
- **[澳洲家庭面临加息与油价突破2澳元](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/jul/25/australian-households-prospect-interest-rate-hike-petrol-prices-rising)**：中东危机推升原油至100美元以上，全球通胀风险再起。

**后续观察**：中东局势若进一步恶化，将直接冲击全球能源市场和地缘政治格局，尤其对依赖进口的亚洲经济体带来连锁压力。同时，欧美内部政治角力（美国历史叙事、ICC信任危机）与气候灾难叠加，预示下半年社会治理难度上升。

military.zh:
## 军事新闻板块日报

**导语：** 过去24小时，全球军事冲突呈现多点联动、经济传导加速的态势。伊朗战争持续升级，美军连续第13天打击伊朗目标，霍尔木兹海峡通航量骤降，国际油价逼近110美元/桶，亚洲炼油商紧急寻找替代供应。与此同时，也门胡塞武装重启对沙特关联船只的封锁，红海与黑海航运同时受威胁，全球三大海上咽喉陷入危机。乌克兰战场出现新变量——首次使用荷兰“Ruta Block 1”巡航导弹，西方低成本远程打击能力加速实战化。中国周边，南海摩擦持续升温，菲律宾指责中方船只连续两日发射水炮，美国则扩大对华科研限制“黑名单”。以下为各子专栏详细分析。

- **全球能源走廊遭多线攻击**：霍尔木兹海峡、红海、黑海同时出现航运阻断事件。CNBC和Reuters均报道，伊朗与乌克兰战争导致物理原油价格飙升，部分合约接近110美元/桶。亚洲炼油商已开始寻找替代原油，市场恐慌情绪蔓延。[Oil shipments are under attack on multiple fronts as fighting escalates in Red Sea, Hormuz and Black Sea - CNBC](https://news.google.)
- **伊朗战争进入“永久危机”状态**：Al Arabiya引述分析称美军在伊朗已展开“重大作战行动”，冲突长期化。美国中央司令部宣布摧毁一艘试图突破封锁的油轮，巴林也报告拦截了伊朗导弹袭击。伊朗则攻击美国在波斯湾的据点，战线扩大。[Iran war: ‘We are in a major combat operation; This has become a perma-crisis’ - Al Arabiya English](https://news.google.)
- **乌克兰首次使用荷兰Ruta巡航导弹**：The War Zone报道，这种低成本巡航导弹的实战亮相标志着乌克兰加速向大规模远程打击能力转型。与此同时，乌克兰无人机部队在黑海猎杀俄船，据Defense News称已击中180余个海上目标。[Evidence Of Ukraine Using Dutch Ruta Block 1 Cruise Missiles Emerges - The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/evidence-of-ukraine-using-dutch-ruta-block-1-cruise-missiles-emerges)
- **南海摩擦升级：菲指责中方水炮，多国声明搅局**：菲律宾称中国海警船连续第二天对其公务船发射水炮。中国外交部回应菲律宾“蓄意挑衅”。王毅在马尼拉阐明立场，强调中国“稳定性与确定性”。十几个国家联合声明介入南海，中国媒体批其“露怯”。[菲指责中方船只连续第二天对其公务船发射水炮 特朗普承诺将与习近平提及菲方关切 - RFI](https://news.google.)
- **美国海军订购低成本导弹，对抗海上威胁**：USNI News报道，美国海军通过CHAOS项目采购低成本巡航导弹，旨在扩大舰队和盟友的远程海上打击能力。同时，美国海岸警卫队开始寻求猎杀无人潜航器（UUV）的技术，以应对港口安全威胁。[U.S. Navy Orders Low-cost Missiles to Expand Fleet, Allied Long-Range Maritime Strike Capabilities - USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/24/u-s-navy-orders-low-cost-missiles-to-expand-fleet-allied-long-range-maritime-strike-capabilities)
- **德国撤回拟部署霍尔木兹的海军舰艇**：Defense News报道，鉴于伊朗战争看不到结束迹象，德国国防部决定撤回原计划用于战后霍尔木兹任务的两艘海军舰艇。这一决定凸显欧洲盟友对冲突长期化的评估。[With no Iran war end in sight, Germany pulls back two navy ships eyed for Hormuz mission - Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/07/24/with-no-iran-war-end-in-sight-germany-pulls-back-two-navy-ships-eyed-for-hormuz-mission/)
- **美国扩大对华科研限制“黑名单”，多所顶尖大学上榜**：美国之音报道，五角大楼将多家中国企业和大学列入“中国军事企业清单”，包括之前未涉及的高校。此举将进一步加剧中美科技脱钩。[五角大楼扩大科研限制“黑名单”，中国多所顶尖大学首次上榜 - 美国之音](https://news.google.)

**后续观察：** 霍尔木兹海峡与红海的封锁正在形成“航运危机共振”，国际油价可能在近期突破110美元并引发全球经济连锁反应。伊朗战争若再持续数周，欧洲盟友的军事承诺将出现裂痕（德国撤舰只是开始）。南海方向，中国与菲律宾的摩擦可能在下周东盟外长会期间激化。乌克兰使用荷兰巡航导弹意味着西方对乌远程打击的限制进一步放松，俄军后方目标将面临更大威胁。
military.en:
The global security landscape is under acute multi-front stress as conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine converge to disrupt energy supplies, trigger record oil prices, and stretch naval resources. In the last 24 hours, the Strait of Hormuz transits have collapsed, Houthi blockades have resumed, and oil prices have surged toward $110/barrel, while the US and Iran continue trading strikes. Meanwhile, Ukraine strikes on Russian ships and Russian ballistic missile attacks on Kyiv escalate the war in Europe. In the Indo-Pacific, US-China tensions simmer over South China Sea incidents and a new Pentagon blacklist targeting Chinese universities. The US Navy advances low-cost allied strike capabilities even as Germany pulls back from Hormuz commitments.

- **Energy choke points on fire**: Oil shipments are under attack across the Red Sea, Strait of Hormuz, and Black Sea ([CNBC](https://news.google.)). Physical crude prices near $110 as Iran and Ukraine wars hit supply ([Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxPaWNvYzRoNkNQa2xmbldvVnNQcWQtRUp3MjFNQmJqRld1Z2R0X0JJSzFUNDJRcTRLelItMUtPd3A0NmUtNmJJZy1jRUNabTVldWxBSld6VDhOQ2VCQVpSV1J4VUg0Yjk4dTI0UlZiMVVWYnFMaDJnQ3JFOGdwLVVYVjV2RnJIWHRla2lOTEhUMEVCbU9rN09nWXdkRzVEbDlKcTZoYUFuTlYtQUxZWlFVWXJudktfNFdaVnBOajZ1WFA5Wk5na0E)).
- **US-Iran conflict deepens**: US forces disabled an Iranian tanker after blockade attempts ([NewsNation](https://news.google.)). Bahraini air defenses intercepted Iranian attacks ([Iran International](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUkFVX3lxTE04dXc0dEhBUkVrMlRzTm1LbFpSdUEwZ000SGRxYkFjc0M0eWhNWk1OSUZQdmdvVFZDSWpOeWstLURua2VZVmNmZVltWk0ycFhaS1E)).
- **Houthi Red Sea blockade deepens**: A Chatham House analysis questions whether collective maritime security will hold ([Chatham House](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxPZTVHQWRucTNhcGFGMGJvRWttU2ZoNTFEeEcwMDNiMmtWYWVGSllJa0lrMWJvSDdBb2x5SEU3YkM4Q0hldjhmTUhhZVlGSjA3V1FUUy1LNl9lMHRpR2gybl9va0w0ZUZtanRJZUkwOEZwZHdJZnh5bFRiWHppakZfZzVZWkRDcmQtTmlRZkVXZmR0NUoxSjBrM0Jmc3hpanFfejg1ajVXZGlCWmpqVXNOYVpUT1N4ajF6TXdkXw)).
- **Ukraine war escalates**: A Ukrainian drone unit hunting Russian ships has hit over 180 vessels ([Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/07/24/from-steppe-to-sea-a-ukrainian-drone-unit-hunts-russian-ships/)). Russia struck a defense industry exhibition near Kyiv, killing at least 10 ([Facebook](https://news.google.)).
- **Naval force posture shifting**: Germany pulls back two navy ships eyed for a Hormuz mission amid no end to Iran war ([Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/07/24/with-no-iran-war-end-in-sight-germany-pulls-back-two-navy-ships-eyed-for-hormuz-mission/)). The White House protests a congressional block on buying foreign warships for the US Navy ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/24/white-house-protests-congressional-block-on-buying-foreign-warships-for-u-s-navy)).
- **US Navy pursues low-cost allied strike missiles**: The CHAOS program selects CoAspire to deliver affordable long-range maritime strike munitions ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/24/u-s-navy-orders-low-cost-missiles-to-expand-fleet-allied-long-range-maritime-strike-capabilities)).
- **China-Philippines confrontation escalates**: Philippines accuses Chinese vessels of water cannon attacks for the second day; Trump pledges to raise the issue with Xi ([RFI](https://news.google.)). Chinese state media denounce Japan-Philippines collusion ([国际在线](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE1fMkpmLW0wTzhOYm1oXzBzamZhcFVCa08wV0VrYm52WXlBTm5VU0Z0WVlxekNLN3U4aVRLMDJTZklqVFZiMElrSXYwTjdfRHpDdTZSdXF3NzBZODQxQXNQQ1ViSHVXMU9MM0NsY1JHY05jMFdibGNaMnhn)).
- **Pentagon expands blacklist**: US adds several top Chinese universities to its research restriction blacklist ([美国之音](https://news.google.)).

**Watch next**: Oil prices may breach $110 as Strait of Hormuz traffic remains at a trickle; watch for further US-Iran strikes and potential Iranian retaliation on Gulf states. The RIMPAC exercise continues, while South China Sea incidents could trigger a new crisis hotline call. The Pentagon's ban on foreign warship purchases will be a key NDAA battleground.

tech.zh:
今日科技新闻焦点密集，地缘政治与技术监管的碰撞加剧：特朗普以欧盟罚谷歌为由威胁加征关税，EU同时应美国请求限制伊朗战争区域的卫星图像；AI领域，中国Kimi K3引发硅谷监管分歧，DeepMind掌门呼吁建立全球AI watchdog，而Anthropic Opus 5更重效率而非能力跃迁；汽车与航天方面，SpaceX星舰V3试飞虽成功但助推器再次失利，特斯拉CEO马斯克宣称开源Model S/X却因先例遭质疑。值得关注的还有Meta暂停智能眼镜收费计划、大众工程师因Rivian合资内幕交易被诉，以及印尼政府下令GitHub移除蓝牙聊天应用Bitchat。

- [特朗普威胁对欧盟加征新关税，回应谷歌被罚](https://www.engadget.com/2222963/trump-threatens-eu-with-new-tariffs-in-response-to-google-fine/)：欧盟委员会认定谷歌搜索排名和反引导违反《数字市场法案》，特朗普将此与贸易挂钩，科技政治化风险升级。
- [Meta暂停智能眼镜“限速”收费计划，隐私争议持续](https://www.theverge.com/tech/970970/after-backlash-meta-pauses-plan-to-rate-limit-its-smart-glasses)：此前拟对本地运行的音频增强功能收$20月费，遭用户猛烈抨击后叫停。与此同时，Meta眼镜被曝成为骚扰工具，女性遭偷拍并上传至Instagram，监管之困显现。
- [大众工程师因Rivian合资内幕交易被起诉](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/24/volkswagen-engineers-charged-with-insider-trading-tied-to-rivian-joint-venture/)：未密封起诉书显示，工程师利用合资机密信息提前买入Rivian股票，汽车业涉股敏感信息再敲警钟。
- [SpaceX星舰V3第13次试飞：搭载20颗V3 Starlink，但助推器再次失效](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/24/spacex-launches-new-v3-starlink-satellites-but-suffers-another-booster-failure/)：星舰任务进展与回收问题并存，此前第12次飞行的助推器问题尚未彻底解决。
- [西班牙野火逼近NASA深空通信设施，损失待评估](https://www.wired.com/story/spanish-wildfires-nasa-deep-space-observatory/)：马德里附近深空网络综合体被迫疏散，欧洲野火对全球航天通信链路构成直接威胁。
- [Waymo被传考虑与Uber分道扬镳](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/24/waymo-reportedly-mulling-a-breakup-with-uber/)：双方合同至2028年5月到期，但Waymo已在评估独立运营，自动驾驶出行格局或生变。

**后续观察**：科技公司正陷入“监管-扩张”的双重夹击——特朗普关税、EU数字监管、政府强制移除应用、野火等不可抗力接连出现；SpaceX的回收难题与大众内幕交易则暴露了工程与治理的脆弱面。下周需重点关注派拉蒙与华纳合并案延期后的司法进展，以及Nothing裁员后的市场反应。
tech.en:
The past 24 hours in technology reveal a landscape shaped by regulatory clashes, corporate reversals, and incremental progress in AI and space. Geopolitical tensions flared as Trump threatened new tariffs over the EU's Google fine, while Meta backtracked on a controversial smart glasses subscription but faces ongoing privacy backlash. SpaceX achieved a milestone with V3 Starlink satellites but suffered another booster failure, tempering reusability gains. In AI, China's Kimi K3 model is deepening Silicon Valley's divide on regulation, while Anthropic's Opus 5 leads the leaderboard through token efficiency rather than raw capability. Tesla's promise to open source Model S and X drew skepticism given its past minimal release, and the Paramount-WBD merger was pushed into 2027 by legal challenges. Meanwhile, BYD and Audi are stretching EV range boundaries with 1,008 km and over 400 miles respectively.

- [Trump threatens EU with new tariffs in response to Google fine](https://www.engadget.com/2222963/trump-threatens-eu-with-new-tariffs-in-response-to-google-fine/) — The European Commission's DMA violation finding triggers a US tariff threat, escalating trade tensions.
- [After backlash, Meta pauses plan to ‘rate limit’ its smart glasses](https://www.theverge.com/tech/970970/after-backlash-meta-pauses-plan-to-rate-limit-its-smart-glasses) — Meta halts a $20/month fee for a local audio feature but the glasses continue to generate privacy incidents.
- [SpaceX launches new V3 Starlink satellites but suffers another booster failure](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/24/spacex-launches-new-v3-starlink-satellites-but-suffers-another-booster-failure/) — The 13th Starship flight deploys 20 V3 satellites, but booster relight issues persist, impacting reusability targets.
- [China’s Kimi K3 Exposes a Growing Divide in Silicon Valley Over AI Regulation](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTFB1em14V2wxUDdRSXBJU2o1ZUdkYW4tNjJQZHV2dV9qSVZCRng3MTNDSjRQVXRqeDVPOVFoT1NuQ0JxYWtNU3dfUENDQzVVUkk0YkJlbURLdmtHQ05weEFfeTRLQ0szYVJtTjU0) — The rise of China's model fuels calls for a global AI watchdog; DeepMind chief urges Washington to act.
- [Anthropic's Opus 5 is about token efficiency, not a capability leap](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/07/anthropics-opus-5-is-about-token-efficiency-not-a-capability-leap/) — Opus 5 tops the leaderboard but the key advance is cost reduction, making advanced AI more accessible.
- [Tesla to ‘open source’ Model S and X, but prior release makes us skeptical](https://electrek.co/2026/07/24/tesla-open-source-model-s-x-roadster-release-audit/) — Musk's promise echoes a previous Roadster release that was minimal and lacked licenses, raising doubts.
- [Paramount agrees to delay Warner Bros. merger into 2027](https://www.engadget.com/2222897/paramount-agrees-to-delay-warner-bros-merger-into-2027/) — The deal is postponed to allow legal challenges from states and the WGA to proceed.

**Watch next:** Keep an eye on how trade tariffs impact tech supply chains, whether AI regulation gains global traction, and how the EV range race reshapes consumer expectations. The outcome of the Paramount-WBD merger trial and Tesla's open source follow-through will also be pivotal.

sports.zh:
今日体育世界迎来多项重磅动态。41岁的勒布朗·詹姆斯宣布将加盟费城76人，称这是其NBA最后一份合同；中国羽毛球公开赛国羽女单强势占据四强半壁江山，男单则全军覆没；广东宏远功勋总经理朱芳雨离任，未来去向引发猜测；足坛方面，曼城中场罗德里将接受背部手术，德国队新帅克洛普以辞职威胁媒体，AC米兰酝酿清洗筹钱。以下是详细盘点：

- **[勒布朗·詹姆斯41岁加盟76人，称“最后一份合同”](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/articles/cx27r0me3zno)**：这位篮球历史级巨星选择在生涯末期联手恩比德与马克西，东部格局瞬间改写，76人成为新赛季头号热门。
- **[中国羽毛球公开赛：国羽女单四强占两席，陈雨菲复仇因达农](https://news.google.)**：男单头号种子石宇奇与翁泓阳双双止步八强，国羽无缘卫冕，暴露男线厚度不足。
- **[朱芳雨离任广东宏远总经理](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5FUlhkSk1sSE5zblcwZnMtMHJLWWx0bFVFM1FiV05SSTR2ZndWbjhjdnVKTlVWS2F1d0NYVlNtbnRvdkJCZ1llNm1ibDYxVGNSQTF5a0VySlpib0RubVZyaGw2QQ)**：这位CBA传奇人物在宏远重建关键期离开，杜锋与球队管理层关系耐人寻味，其本人退役后是否转型解说员亦成话题。
- **[曼城中场罗德里将接受背部手术](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c36dw0nwexxo)**：新帅马雷斯卡确认此事，对曼城中场运转影响巨大，瓜迪奥拉时期的核心体系面临调整。
- **[克洛普以辞职威胁德国媒体](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cqjxd0n4gd2o)**：德国队新主帅上任首日便划下红线，显示其保护家庭隐私的强硬立场，媒体与国家队关系面临新考验。

**后续观察**：勒布朗的加盟将引爆NBA自由市场后续连锁反应；中国羽毛球公开赛女单中日对决格局延续，韩悦能否爆冷山口茜值得关注；朱芳雨离开后的广东宏远转会操作将检验新管理层的成色；足坛转会窗进入冲刺期，米兰、拜仁等队的动向牵动球迷心弦。
sports.en:
The past 24 hours delivered a whirlwind of major sports narratives, from LeBron James' blockbuster move to the Philadelphia 76ers and Tadej Pogacar's domination on Alpe d'Huez, to a mixed bag of results at the Chinese Badminton Open and significant football off-field drama. The biggest headlines reshape NBA landscape, reinforce cycling's hierarchy, and bring clarity to heavyweight boxing's looming showdown. Meanwhile, the 2026 Commonwealth Games kicked off with both glory and a frightening injury, and the Hungarian Grand Prix practice suggested Ferrari's resurgence.

- [NBA superstar James, 41, to join Philadelphia 76ers](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/articles/cx27r0me3zno) — LeBron James announced his final NBA contract with the 76ers, instantly altering the balance of power in the Eastern Conference and sending shockwaves through the league's trade and free agency calculus.
- [Pogacar on verge of fifth Tour title after Alpe d'Huez win](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/cycling/articles/c2elrwxe941o) — Tadej Pogacar's stage 19 victory puts him on the brink of a fifth Tour de France crown, equaling a record and cementing his status as the era's dominant Grand Tour rider.
- [Fury wins low-key warm-up to keep Joshua fight on track](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/boxing/articles/cy5dnnq1l0po) — Tyson Fury's routine win in Thailand contrasts with his verbal jab questioning Anthony Joshua's courage, keeping the all-British heavyweight blockbuster alive but tense.
- [Horror injury overshadows gymnastics silver at Commonwealths](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/articles/c151qlnzw05o) — England's Gabriel Langton suffered a serious fall during the team event, casting a shadow over the silver medal and raising concerns about gymnastic safety protocols.
- [Hamilton fastest as new Aston Martin makes encouraging debut](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/formula1/articles/c3v0wp9yvdgo) — Ferrari locked out the front row in Hungarian GP practice, signaling a potential shift in the constructors' standings battle against Red Bull.
- [Rodri to have back surgery but Maresca brushes off transfer speculation](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c36dw0nwexxo) — The World Cup winner's surgery sidelines a key Manchester City anchor, with new manager Enzo Maresca downplaying any transfer market panic ahead of the season.
- [中国公开赛：国羽占据女单四强半壁江山！陈雨菲2-1复仇前世界第一](https://news.google.) — China's women's singles dominance at the home tournament continued, with Chen Yufei avenging a previous loss and two other Chinese players advancing to the semifinals.

**Watch next:** All eyes turn to Saturday's heavyweight doubleheader: Anthony Joshua vs. Kristian Prenga and the Hungarian Grand Prix qualifying, plus the conclusion of the Tour de France and the Chinese Badminton Open finals. The LeBron James signing will fuel trade speculations for days, while the outcomes of the Commonwealth Games will continue to unfold.

entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐板块的核心剧情是一场围绕权力与话语权的多维角力：特朗普在白宫记者协会晚宴上的强硬回击、好莱坞对AI的集体防御、以及中韩市场在数据与争议中寻找新平衡。跨国并购案因法律阻挠而股价受挫，预告片引发的诽谤威胁则暴露了流媒体与金融科技间的紧张关系。以下为过去24小时的重点动态：

- **特朗普与媒体交锋升级**：总统在华盛顿记者晚宴上发表超一小时演讲，自称面对的是“有史以来最大的特朗普精神错乱人群”。[详情](https://deadline.com/2026/07/trump-white-house-correspondents-dinner-2-1237002716/) 与此同时，《侠探杰克》主演Alan Ritchson在播客中激烈抨击特朗普，白宫迅速出面辩护。[报道](https://www.rollingstone.com/tv-movies/tv-movie-news/alan-ritchson-trump-epstein-files-white-house-response-1235598785/)
- **AI红线与吉尔莫·德尔·托罗的宣言**：导演在SDCC上明确表示《潘神的迷宫》3D重映“绝对不使用任何该死的AI”，并强调这是对艺术谱系的保护。[综合](https://www.rollingstone.com/tv-movies/tv-movie-news/guillermo-del-toro-pans-labyrinth-3d-re-release-no-ai-1235598765/) 此举呼应了行业对AI侵蚀创作的普遍警惕。
- **流媒体法律战开打**：预测市场平台Kalshi因Netflix纪录片预告片涉嫌误导而发出律师函，指控平台暗示其违抗内华达州法庭禁令。[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/kalshi-threatens-netflix-misleading-prediction-market-doc-1237003123/) 与[THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/kalshi-netflix-defamation-trailer-prediction-markets-1236656342/) 交叉印证了双方分歧。
- **媒体并购再遇波折**：派拉蒙与华纳兄弟探索的合并反垄断诉讼被推迟，两公司股价盘后下跌，加州总检察长称协议要求派拉蒙在6月1日前不得完成交易。[报道](https://deadline.com/2026/07/paramount-wbd-merger-antitrust-lawsuit-delay-reactions-1237003045/)
- **K-pop纪录与韩剧收官**：BLACKPINK《DDU-DU DDU-DU》MV成为首支突破24亿观看量的K-pop组合MV。[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857250wpp/blackpinks-ddu-du-ddu-du-becomes-1st-k-pop-group-mv-ever-to-hit-2-4-billion-views) 同时，韩剧《特工金重启》即将大结局，收视稳居同时段第一。[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857257wpp/agent-kim-reactivated-heads-into-finale-on-no-1-ratings)
- **中国影视市场冷热交织**：猫眼娱乐预告半年转亏最多5500万元，主因电影票房跌四成，暑期档反弹尚未完全回血。[星岛头条](https://news.google.) 另一方面，王一博因赛车活动安保问题被车评人质疑“耍官威”，团队冷处理，粉丝则发起反击。[世界新闻网](https://news.google.)
- **微博社区热议：剧集长尾效应与热搜争议**：《莲花楼》播出三周年之际，网友对比当年与《长相思》的热搜数量，认为前者凭借内容而非营销赢得持久热度。[新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9scTJNOFNyaHdDanoxVUJaM2drMFhWR2VNNEtOdFJleUxreXRuNXhQTVdJYlNBM3ZmamlpU3NUdnJEc2lnUlFBTl9yRkJjVXA4RDZyLTh6T0ctamJCLWVqczB1QQ) 此外，林依轮复刻任嘉伦《周生如故》红衣造型登上热搜，引发“蹭热度”争议。另有话题#热搜只提白鹿不提任嘉伦#在粉丝间掀起讨论。

**后续观察**：特朗普与媒体的对抗将持续发酵；流媒体与金融平台的法律冲突可能成为行业模板；中国影视市场在暑期档后半段能否真正回暖，需关注猫眼等平台后续财报。
entertainment.en:
The entertainment landscape in the last 24 hours is defined by high-stakes legal threats, industry consolidation drama, and a vibrant mix of fan culture and technological debate. From Kalshi's defamation suit against Netflix to the delayed Paramount-WBD merger, the business of entertainment is as contentious as ever. Meanwhile, Guillermo del Toro's emphatic anti-AI stance at Comic-Con and BLACKPINK's historic YouTube milestone offer bright spots, while Chinese markets show signs of strain. Social media in China is buzzing with fan wars and celebrity comebacks.

- **Kalshi vs. Netflix**: Prediction market Kalshi has threatened Netflix with a defamation suit over a trailer that allegedly misrepresents a court order, highlighting the growing tension between streaming docs and real-world legal risks [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/kalshi-threatens-netflix-misleading-prediction-market-doc-1237003123/).
- **Paramount-WBD Merger Delay**: After a legal delay pushed the $110B deal back, stocks slid and opponents celebrated. The antitrust lawsuit's outcome could reshape media consolidation [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/paramount-wbd-merger-antitrust-lawsuit-delay-reactions-1237003045/).
- **Trump Roasts Media at Correspondents' Dinner**: President Trump's hour-long, rally-style speech at the rescheduled White House Correspondents' Dinner drew sharp reactions, with Variety and Hollywood Reporter covering the event [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/trump-white-house-correspondents-dinner-remarks-1236820779/).
- **Del Toro No AI Pledge**: Guillermo del Toro assured fans that the 3D re-release of 'Pan's Labyrinth' used 'absolutely no goddamn AI,' reinforcing his commitment to traditional artistry [Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/tv-movies/tv-movie-news/guillermo-del-toro-pans-labyrinth-3d-re-release-no-ai-1235598765/).
- **BLACKPINK Makes YouTube History**: 'DDU-DU DDU-DU' became the first K-pop group MV to hit 2.4 billion views, underscoring the sustained global power of K-pop [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857250wpp/blackpinks-ddu-du-ddu-du-becomes-1st-k-pop-group-mv-ever-to-hit-2-4-billion-views).
- **Chinese Box Office Woes**: Maoyan Entertainment expects a loss of up to 55M yuan in H1, with China's film box office down 40% year-on-year, though the summer season is showing some rebound [星島頭條](https://news.google.).
- **Weibo Fan Wars**: The comparison between 'The Legend of Shen Li' and 'The Lotus Casebook' three years after their run sparked debates about marketing vs. lasting popularity, while actor Wang Yibo faced criticism over alleged 'official arrogance' on a racing track [新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9scTJNOFNyaHdDanoxVUJaM2drMFhWR2VNNEtOdFJleUxreXRuNXhQTVdJYlNBM3ZmamlpU3NUdnJEc2lnUlFBTl9yRkJjVXA4RDZyLTh6T0ctamJCLWVqczB1QQ).

**Watch next**: The Kalshi-Netflix legal battle could set a precedent for documentary liability, while the Paramount-WBD saga will continue to influence investor sentiment. Comic-Con buzz may drive early box office for 'Pan's Labyrinth' re-release, and Chinese box office recovery will be closely watched as summer blockbusters roll out. Weibo drama around idol feuds and comebacks will likely intensify.

美股.zh:
美股本周以科技股领跌，特斯拉单周暴跌18%成为最大拖累，同时债券市场对AI资本支出的担忧加剧，信用利差走阔。特朗普关税政策再起波澜——新关税遭起诉，且威胁对欧盟加税，加重市场不确定性。SpaceX在IPO后首次试飞星舰，成败将影响太空概念股情绪。
- [Tesla suffers worst slump since 2022](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/tesla-tsla-spcx-stock-starship-test-flight-musk-bad-week.html) — 财报不及预期和现金流转负是下跌主因
- [Bond market anxiety over AI capex](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/bond-market-anxiety-ai-capex-spending.html) — 谷歌、亚马逊、Meta信用利差扩大，市场质疑AI投资回报
- [Trump tariffs challenged in court](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/trump-tariffs-lawsuit-301-ieepa.html) — 新关税生效数小时后即遭到起诉，法律挑战或削弱政策效力
- [Trump threatens EU with tariffs](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/trump-tariffs-eu-trade-google-apple-tech.html) — 特朗普在社交媒体指责欧盟“抢劫”美科技巨头
- [SpaceX Starship test flight since IPO](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/spacex-launches-massive-starship-rocket-in-first-test-flight-since-ipo.html) — 星舰试飞是IPO后首次重大测试，市场屏息关注
总体看，美股短期面临关税政策反复、科技龙头业绩放缓和AI开支质疑三重压力，波动率可能上升。
美股.en:
US equities face a volatile mix of renewed tariff escalations, an oil price spike, and diverging corporate fortunes. Tesla suffered its worst weekly slump since 2022, while SpaceX's Starship test flight dominated headlines. Bond markets are signaling unease over AI spending.

- **Tariff Shock & Legal Battle:** Trump's new 25% tariffs on Brazil and 50% threat on Canada face an immediate lawsuit; experts question their durability. Separately, Trump threatened the EU with 'substantial tariff' over tech fines ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/trump-tariffs-lawsuit-301-ieepa.html), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/trump-tariffs-eu-trade-google-apple-tech.html)).
- **Musk's Turbulent Week:** Tesla shares plunged 18% after a weak earnings report and negative cash flow. Meanwhile, SpaceX launched its Starship rocket in the first test flight since its IPO – a high-stakes moment for Musk's reputation ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/tesla-tsla-spcx-stock-starship-test-flight-musk-bad-week.html), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/spacex-launches-massive-starship-rocket-in-first-test-flight-since-ipo.html)).
- **Bond Market Anxiety on AI Capex:** Google, Amazon, and Meta see widening credit spreads as fixed-income investors demand higher compensation for AI-related capital expenditure risks ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/bond-market-anxiety-ai-capex-spending.html)).
- **Paramount-WBD Delay & Uber-Waymo Shift:** Paramount agreed to delay its Warner Bros. Discovery acquisition to June 2027 amid legal challenges. Uber and Waymo will end exclusivity in Atlanta and Austin by 2028 ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/paramount-wbd-merger-delay.html), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/uber-and-waymo-to-end-exclusivity-arrangement-in-atlanta-and-austin.html)).
- **Tech Wealth Boom Drives Auction Records:** Auction houses report nearly $10 billion in H1 sales, fueled by tech wealth chasing dinosaur bones, art, and watches ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/wealth-auctions-art-watches.html)).

**Signal:** The combination of tariff uncertainty, oil at $100, and AI capex skepticism suggests a risk-off tilt in the near term, but tech IPO activity (SpaceX) and wealth effects continue to provide pockets of strength.

欧洲经济.zh:
欧洲央行7月会议维持利率不变，但措辞鹰派，交易员押注9月加息。能源价格因伊朗冲突飙升至100美元/桶，强化加息预期，但欧元区企业调查显示消费者提价困难，经济复苏基础仍脆弱。欧洲股市整体承压，IBEX 35跌1.55%。
- [ECB holds rates steady, keeps tightening bias](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxNNTZqb3ZJRTZVN3JfYmwwVlExTUJNOGwwOE5xUUNsWEl2U1pFQzNqYmFYRjF2Wk53d3p1NHJlR3NyZUlXTFNnT3JLdTVLbUpuR3VCdThUMkREdmlrY1I2VWpOWTJjQkx3Rnd2QVlWRFlhNE96eUFhVE1HN0xaTTZxZGdOQmZaUXZwZjBmWElZZmp5VXpxYmROODZ2aVVNY3FocXJrTG5ZSQ) — 能源价格高企为9月加息铺路
- [Euro zone firms struggle to raise prices after Iran shock](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxObTF5dE9zRGFHbjdISXMzTWMxT21xNXhfSDRxeEdsZEVtVHVkM1Z3LWh4NmxpTGx4dTBVeXhQaVlhaUQ1azRwSEs3WTZZVU5mU3JJRHFjZzdMWUJZOXdFa2F6QWNhVE1mNlc0dEZEVFpWRnRzY25ETGEyNmdGWmI5djYtRFNwYVhacWRhUWpIdUtQTm5JMHlWZHBqUjZvUm43bnZBMFV4TldZaTBKb1J6ci1R) — ECB调查显示企业提价受阻
- [European markets hold steady as oil and tariffs fuel rate concerns](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxQdDczOXp1bW96NzFVeDZhVXJqQVRKQ1pGUHJpSkdIMFFjRml3UmwyVXhnQ3Ridm9jVV85TTJ1dDhnNkVvdnphVWtwTjhfbkcycUNSZGxTQzFYREJpXzhoc19oMDNvU1praTk0RU9PR0dZU3dhSXZqUzJCa3ZQV2t3M2g5NFh1NGNBWG1henJn) — 欧股整体持稳但隐含担忧
- [ECB to extend use of climate factors in collateral framework](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260724_4~f082ce289d.en.html) — 绿色金融政策继续推进
欧洲经济处于“滞胀”边缘：能源冲击推高通胀，但消费需求疲软，ECB的平衡术面临考验。
欧洲经济.en:
European markets held steady this week despite soaring oil prices and new US tariffs, as the ECB maintained a tightening bias. The central bank's hawkish stance supports the euro, but firms struggle to pass on higher costs after the Iran shock.

- **ECB Holds Rates, Signals September Hike:** The ECB kept rates unchanged but flagged risks from energy prices, with traders pricing in a September rate increase. The central bank also extended climate factors in its collateral framework ([ECB](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260724_4~f082ce289d.en.html), [International Business Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxQaDRFZ21vNE9LM25IdXZUbGJwbnJ2UFRFZ2pUZUg4aWJYYWNvZWhGTmlBOFVYMEdNMDJPQnRzS1lhUFFRcnRSbmJUdi1tWXk5djVzMUhVX3ZDWGJrWFc0TVpsZGdsdV83V3Nfd21TdTl5Yzd4NnRjUmZ4bUtmRE1paUxOcVZfVk9BR0w0Z3JfdXNJbVJLekNRTjFGelQyOWN2REZDRDFkNA)).
- **Oil and Tariffs Hit Sentiment:** European indices (DAX, CAC, FTSE100) held steady but under pressure as oil above $100 and new US tariffs fueled rate concerns. Spain's Ibex 35 dropped 1.55% ([Yahoo Finance UK](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijgFBVV95cUxQdDczOXp1bW96NzFVeDZhVXJqQVRKQ1pGUHJpSkdIMFFjRml3UmwyVXhnQ3Ridm9jVV85TTJ1dDhnNkVvdnphVWtwTjhfbkcycUNSZGxTQzFYREJpXzhoc19oMDNvU1praTk0RU9PR0dZU3dhSXZqUzJCa3ZQV2t3M2g5NFh1NGNBWG1henJn), [The Corner .eu](https://news.google.)).
- **Euro Zone Firms Struggle to Raise Prices:** An ECB poll showed firms find it difficult to pass on costs after the Iran shock, complicating the inflation outlook ([WTVB](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxObTF5dE9zRGFHbjdISXMzTWMxT21xNXhfSDRxeEdsZEVtVHVkM1Z3LWh4NmxpTGx4dTBVeXhQaVlhaUQ1azRwSEs3WTZZVU5mU3JJRHFjZzdMWUJZOXdFa2F6QWNhVE1mNlc0dEZEVFpWRnRzY25ETGEyNmdGWmI5djYtRFNwYVhacWRhUWpIdUtQTm5JMHlWZHBqUjZvUm43bnZBMFV4TldZaTBKb1J6ci1R)).
- **EU Carbon Market Shake-Up:** A major reform of the EU's carbon market is underway, with implications for the green economy and corporate compliance costs ([BusinessGreen](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxOVTRXME9xOFBfWDE0T1hORlZralVRR3d0aDYzeWN4LXhlcEZJUTdZd0dUSV9oanM0SFNWYktLc1VUUUtyaFFSSXdjT1JCR1pNaVhCS282aF9BTW5UWi1oUXllWTRudTZTUXNIb28yTzBHYlFkbm9fM19wUmtkSU9hVE1TdmpJU0FFV29NMEd1ejd4eFE)).
- **ECB Enhances Repo Facility for Central Banks:** The ECB will start implementing an enhanced repo facility to support liquidity management ([ECB](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260724_2~d7d475d2f0.en.html)).

**Signal:** The ECB's balancing act between inflation from energy and weak demand will keep rates elevated, with a September hike increasingly likely – watch for PMI data next week as a key input.

中国经济.zh:
中国监管与改革双线并进：Trip.com被罚7.65亿美元（反垄断），原证监会副主席方星海被调查（反腐）；同时港交所推出八年最大上市改革，AgiBot等AI公司争赴港IPO。宁德时代二季度利润创纪录，但电动车主业放缓，公司启动A股史上最大回购。港股大涨2.4%，恒指重回25143点。
- [China hits Trip.com with US$765 million antitrust penalty](https://www.scmp.com/tech/policy/article/3361818/china-hits-tripcom-us765-million-antitrust-penalty-after-six-month-investigation) — 在线旅游领域反垄断标志性案件
- [China places former CSRC vice-chair under investigation](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3361782/china-places-former-deputy-top-financial-regulator-under-investigation) — 方星海案显示金融反腐持续深入
- [Hong Kong exchange’s biggest reform in 8 years](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3361742/hong-kong-exchanges-biggest-reform-8-years-opens-gates-more-ipos) — 港股IPO门槛降低，吸引科技初创
- [CATL posts record quarterly profit, launches largest buyback](https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/3361795/chinese-battery-giant-catl-posts-record-quarterly-profits-amid-green-energy-boom) — 宁德时代业绩与回购并进
- [AgiBot begins Hong Kong IPO process](https://news.google.) — 具身智能赛道IPO升温
监管趋严但资本市场改革提速，同时资金（ETF净流入）和龙头公司回购提供信心，中国经济板块短期或有分化。
中国经济.en:
Chinese markets saw mixed signals: a landmark antitrust fine on Trip.com, record profits at CATL, and major HKEX listing reforms aimed at attracting IPOs. The CSRC also pledged more medium- and long-term capital into markets, while a former top regulator was placed under investigation.

- **Trip.com Hit with $765M Antitrust Penalty:** China's market regulator fined Trip.com Group for monopolistic conduct, a significant enforcement action that signals continued regulatory scrutiny of tech platforms ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/tech/policy/article/3361818/china-hits-tripcom-us765-million-antitrust-penalty-after-six-month-investigation)).
- **CATL Posts Record Profit but Misses Estimates:** The battery giant reported record quarterly revenue and net profit, but weakness in China's EV demand limited upside. The company announced A-share's largest single buyback plan ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/3361795/chinese-battery-giant-catl-posts-record-quarterly-profits-amid-green-energy-boom), [第一财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE1rejJkVndhRHBHdXo1REpuM05ldk51NzRocGQ4RnhBQnZRcWF0SDFPTXg0NUxIMUcxS1FkUDFVOWhQa1RTQXNwbFNxSThPd3RZa2Fz)).
- **HKEX Unveils Biggest Listing Reforms in 8 Years:** Confidential filings and reduced market cap requirements for startups and international firms aim to revive IPO activity in Hong Kong ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3361742/hong-kong-exchanges-biggest-reform-8-years-opens-gates-more-ipos)).
- **CSRC Vows to Channel Long-Term Capital:** The securities regulator announced measures to stabilize markets and attract medium- and long-term capital, including from state-backed funds ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3361682/securities-watchdog-channel-more-medium-and-long-term-capital-china-markets)).
- **Former CSRC Vice-Chair Under Investigation:** Fang Xinghai is being probed for corruption, underscoring the ongoing anti-corruption campaign in financial regulation ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3361782/china-places-former-deputy-top-financial-regulator-under-investigation)).
- **Hang Seng Surges 2.4%:** Offshore Chinese equities led regional gains, aided by the HKEX reforms and CSRC support pledges ([BBN Times](https://news.google.)).

**Signal:** The fine on Trip.com and the investigation of Fang Xinghai show Beijing is balancing market liberalization with regulatory discipline; the success of HKEX reforms will be a key test for investor confidence in Chinese equities.

同花顺社区动态.zh:
同花顺社区本周热议监管动向与资金流向。证监会原副主席方星海被查引发广泛讨论；证券公司分类评价结果出炉，14家获AA级。资金面上，宽基ETF本周净流入超500亿，单日205亿，显示抄底意愿。个股方面，千亿半导体龙头逆势吸金超24亿，居A股第一；宁德时代回购消息也成焦点。
- [中国证监会原副主席方星海接受审查调查](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9ySHFJbkpoaXJOQnBaTlFwb0Y0U2hHbUhPNWVBMkx2Q0Q2aWNCcElUbHJlV050Y0NWd3hEWHpGYkZ2NnBrc1JTQnpJclhyUFptMHR3dnBxRENIUWFlR1E) — 社区讨论涉案背景及对券商板块影响
- [本周宽基ETF净流入超500亿](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE52NUg4UnY1aFBWcUhCcXNVZHoxWHpVdFk3X0xuNlNVeVFRSXNtTmtJSWtEMU96WWtLWm1mWFFmN3JxZUNtcXJ2QVR4VHA5ek44clZvWGR6RThMVTJ4clE) — 资金持续入场，社区热议“国家队”动向
- [千亿半导体龙头逆势吸金超24亿](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9lYkJ6VTJKZzc3WmRiaUNfNGdRTUxKQnYtdWVaS3REZTUzdjJhYldsLVJUWG9fTUh4UFROcEdOSFlQT2w5UldHalJTckNXNHhYbkJiN2JtT3FZdjJIWXc) — 社区聚焦半导体板块逆势走强逻辑
- [2026年证券公司分类评价结果出炉，14家获AA级](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1fZW9XMG15Yy1QNmk4dzEyZXBFVGRvbU9kZGJ4LW1aeFJxQWlYOWFUTWhic2FyclZSTnFQal9iY0hVdEtPcHJ6LVZEcW9HaVM1MjlueUJxVHg5cHlaSEhoc2J3) — 分类评价结果影响券商业务拓展预期
- [宁德时代回应发起A股史上最大单次回购](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE1rejJkVndhRHBHdXo1REpuM05ldk51NzRocGQ4RnhBQnZRcWF0SDFPTXg0NUxIMUcxS1FkUDFVOWhQa1RTQXNwbFNxSThPd3RZa2Fz) — 社区对回购规模和时机分歧较大
社区情绪偏谨慎中带乐观，监管利空被解读为“靴子落地”，资金持续流入显示部分投资者认为市场底部已近。
同花顺社区动态.en:
Chinese retail investors focused on strong ETF inflows and regulatory developments this week. The community highlighted record weekly ETF net inflows exceeding 500 billion yuan and the probe into former CSRC vice-chair Fang Xinghai.

- **Weekly ETF Net Inflows Exceed 500 Billion Yuan:** Broad-based ETF products saw massive capital inflows, indicating strong retail participation and possible state-backed support ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE52NUg4UnY1aFBWcUhCcXNVZHoxWHpVdFk3X0xuNlNVeVFRSXNtTmtJSWtEMU96WWtLWm1mWFFmN3JxZUNtcXJ2QVR4VHA5ek44clZvWGR6RThMVTJ4clE)).
- **ETF Net Inflow of 205.77 Billion Yuan on July 24:** A single-day inflow further confirms sustained buying pressure in exchange-traded funds ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFB0aWNnTWV3RmhiY0Vpd0ViUTRSN1JYUDVRdG1qRjhBRlg2ZWoyN09kZzd6b2ZhVEg4UEhraTN3Q0RTWWVDYS1XU3NaSFFyRldRQm1RbElRblhiREhGVWc)).
- **Fang Xinghai Under Investigation:** The former CSRC vice-chair's corruption probe was widely discussed, with implications for regulatory integrity and market sentiment ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9ySHFJbkpoaXJOQnBaTlFwb0Y0U2hHbUhPNWVBMkx2Q0Q2aWNCcElUbHJlV050Y0NWd3hEWHpGYkZ2NnBrc1JTQnpJclhyUFptMHR3dnBxRENIUWFlR1E)).
- **2026 Securities Firm Classification Results:** 14 firms were rated AA, a key benchmark for broker credibility and business scope ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1fZW9XMG15Yy1QNmk4dzEyZXBFVGRvbU9kZGJ4LW1aeFJxQWlYOWFUTWhic2FyclZSTnFQal9iY0hVdEtPcHJ6LVZEcW9HaVM1MjlueUJxVHg5cHlaSEhoc2J3)).
- **Semiconductor Leader Attracts Over 24 Billion Yuan in Net Inflows:** A top semiconductor stock was the largest beneficiary of capital inflows, highlighting continued retail interest in tech ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9lYkJ6VTJKZzc3WmRiaUNfNGdRTUxKQnYtdWVaS3REZTUzdjJhYldsLVJUWG9fTUh4UFROcEdOSFlQT2w5UldHalJTckNXNHhYbkJiN2JtT3FZdjJIWXc)).

**Signal:** The combination of massive ETF inflows and the regulatory probe suggests that retail investors are betting on state support for markets, but the investigation could signal a broader crackdown that may temper short-term enthusiasm.

欧美.zh:
中东战火与欧洲野火成为今日欧美两大焦点，美国内部政治亦未平静。美伊军事对峙升级，特朗普一方面展示强硬，另一方面又放话谈判，矛盾信号令市场不安；欧洲南部高温干旱助长野火，法国西班牙双双进入紧急状态。

- **[美伊互袭后特朗普称“锁定目标”但寻求谈判](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/7/25/iran-war-live-trump-says-us-locked-and-loaded-as-it-seeks-iran-talks)**：伊朗谴责美国计划动用冻结资产支付战争赔款，双方在波斯湾的摩擦引发对全面冲突的担忧。
- **[法西野火迫使超22万人撤离，波尔多告急](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/czjlenp0xk8o)**：法国消防员奋力阻止火势靠近波尔多，马德里宣布区域“最严重火灾”，气候危机正从预测变为现实。
- **[特朗普出席白宫记者协会晚宴并调侃媒体](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cd7le4ylev2o)**：这是4月枪击事件后的补办活动，特朗普借此强化个人形象；同日他下令史密森尼博物馆标注“不准确历史”，持续推动文化战争。
- **[俄军导弹袭击基辅附近无人机展致10死](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cj637zd1k1ko)**：乌克兰国防工业代表遭精准打击，泽连斯基因解除防长职务引发国内政治风波，批评者认为其政治资本受损。

欧美社会当前处于多重压力叠加期：战争、野火、政治极化，三者相互激荡。短期内，市场对中东局势的敏感度将主导风险情绪。

日韩.zh:
日韩今日新闻聚焦制度变革与历史叙事：日本设立新情报机构强化国家安全，韩国则在世界杯失利后反思体制，同时通过归还文物改善对华关系。经济层面，日元疲软与珠宝消费创新高形成对照。

- **[日本将于7月底启动新情报机构及监督机构](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxOZHdLUDdZQlBzdGZaSkFzOGlzZUhYd3BTU2MtdTdtY2w3bktKRDUyR0RDQThKU1g3UlNUdUVZNlhBcTd1WWRrNzhSVHFlbFFfTzd0eThEZDc1bG5KUkRwdWJ4NGczRXhmOHFIbkJoQXdGTlpQZ2pKUkNMOEZ5YmFYTU9jSmkzazFQbm5RTVRoRVRrcXFPS1B4Wm9qbnVVZlZ6Yjd5YXdsR3N0eGRMWDVoaGdNT05lWEE)**：此举旨在增强对外情报收集与内部监督能力，反映日本安全政策持续转型。
- **[韩国世界杯出局引发体制审视](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxPN08tcmZFSndBV3YxTmRGdTVIcE53cVR2c3doYU9kY3pyR2lHeHQ1Ri0wLWxmUkNrNi0yME1fdERyQU1PMmJ2SmZVWFFwS0NGSmtLQ3VpQlJNQ3JSdEM5c2Z6alBvYUFVSFktMWR1WS1fcjN6SXVoZUhQWEFnR1VjdFdPcnhLMnI0)**：舆论开始质疑青训体系与联赛质量，与日本足球的长期发展形成对比。
- **[韩国归还清朝石狮给中国，文化外交告捷](https://news.google.)**：中方对此表示欢迎，此次归还被视为中韩关系回暖的积极信号。
- **[日本珠宝销售创纪录，日元贬值刺激消费](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxPN0N4aEJKdkFvUWltR3NMQVozeExOUUV3R3F0WDVQNGlrcWVBUUkxSmxHTjMtb3hfcTVPZ0UxRlk5R0lnZHlIeEVxbXFzNXRnS3ZOeHlFcWowbjZVQ3Y2djdjNWNBalBSa0pObGNiZm9vWl9NM2lJWnNQMk51OTZsb1NvWnRJX00)**：本土消费者趁日元低位购买高端珠宝，但分析师警告日元干预可能延后。

日韩正同步推进安全与外交调整，日本强化情报能力，韩国则在体育挫折后寻求文化修复。两国经济均受汇率波动影响，消费者行为分化明显。

中国.zh:
今日中国社会新闻以教育成就与宏观政策为主线。多篇报道聚焦基础教育自信、菲尔兹奖得主热议，以及教育部部署“十五五”规划。同时，社会稳定形势、医疗援外等正面议题持续释放信号。

- **[中国基础教育：规模普及与质量飞跃](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE4wUE9WN1R3R0tjWmxKTklNNzU0SGtETmxlNjZNWXV5LXpkcVNGZzBORFVkM0U1SkIwNWtFLW9aSnlkWHNYbUh1M0xka2tleUY5VHJFUTJ2aUFxUXpRTzB4S0k0a2NWYnhSUjZZZGZVZ0tTcDFycjZfdS1QVVJjZw)**：通过数据和案例展示从“有学上”到“上好学”的转变，回应外界对中国教育质量的质疑。
- **[两位中国数学家获2026年菲尔兹奖，知乎热议](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiX0FVX3lxTE5VS2xWRkJnc0pyTkJYN1ZqdE9DYUpoUmNJYTI5TFQ0NVdvdkxPWDRKRnkxYXVLODB4S3NGUGhvRWRiUU8zWjJIRHNIQ1pnUFlsQ3lMNWZHLWgzeXdxeFp3)**：邓煜等天才获最高荣誉，但网络评价出现分化，折射出公众对学术明星的复杂心态。
- **[教育部部长详解“十五五”教育重点工作](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTFB1WnhYdjVPbmc4dDJkSmFCMmE2blhxYzAtX0diOGNzZDlLcXFNbzNKNVYzbnJGS204ck13M3pLVGFyMVhJZ016QTNuODhfOUpabGQtTDZldlg4SVd6Mm9NYTBhZm9nYV83)**：强调加快建设教育强国，涉及基础教育、高等教育与职业教育协同。
- **[公安机关全力保障“十五五”开局稳定](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxOSnN1WTBDVFpOcF9SbjVwdnlSbmNqeW50aHhRQjhvU1pONXpwblAwQnUwbldYeE1QUGZFVURYQXQyXzJXMGtITVcyenR0YVNoaVhLZzhvU2RmZmJSUXVZTHFnMzZJQ0l2cjg1MU5qU19lSElFc09TbUM2N1ZyN2tfZjh3cGg2dw)**：官方通报社会治安持续向好，为政策周期提供稳定基础。

中国社会今日主题是“信心”：教育自信、科研自信、治理自信。但菲尔兹奖得主遭遇网络非议也提示，精英成就与社会情绪之间存在张力。

知乎社区动态.zh:
知乎社区今日因菲尔兹奖得主话题意外“蹭到热度”，同时自身财报显示营收下滑，CEO周源明确转向AI商业化。此外，新浪新闻大举布局原创栏目，社区内容竞争加剧。

- **[知乎2025年营收下滑23.6%，周源称加速AI商业化](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ)**：亏损压力下，知乎试图通过AI工具和内容生成寻找新增长点，挑战在于不破坏社区调性。
- **[菲尔兹奖得主邓煜在知乎也遭骂](https://news.google.)**：部分用户对数学家提出非学术质疑，反映知乎社区讨论质量参差不齐，也暴露平台对高知话题的引导乏力。
- **[小红书、B站、知乎“暗战”WAIC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9Gc0xiVHVPTlRFWHJ3cGNadXlMb1pCZ2x6X0s1LTB5YjExOEpoQVNQVkFEUW1uWktGbWxfY0JTcjJaQUZsWV9PNjdNMHdZODVrRXNXNGk5LWFBMjljYS1EM0lR)**：在世界人工智能大会上三平台争夺创作者与话题热度，知乎面临流量分流压力。
- **[新浪新闻携手李诞、陈鲁豫等打造原创IP](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxPLU5sV3I5SllKTktSY3ZhTFJ6TlNjcThVVW82VzZzTFF4Mkc3Vm1nWjJrZTRiQnFubWdPbURMZUR1VnRQY2phZ3h0OG5xTlNGM3J3TERUZTl0dVI5cmdSM2ZsX1kwUkhWY2FWNXNNcmRpMm5BN052X2tlRF9VbUx3TXE4VDhtWWhTSWFtYjkyNi1WMEJz)**：传统门户通过名人效应增强内容壁垒，进一步挤压知乎等UGC平台的广告收入空间。

知乎正处于转型阵痛期：流量红利消退，AI商业化方向尚未证明成功，而竞争对手正从内容与人才两端围剿。菲尔兹奖的热度虽带来短期声量，但无法掩盖基本面挑战。

冲突局势.zh:
**概览：** 全球三大能源海峡同时告急——霍尔木兹、红海、黑海均出现武装冲突阻断航运，国际油价单日飙升逼近110美元。伊朗与美国在波斯湾的互相打击已进入第13天，胡塞武装重启对沙特船只的封锁，乌克兰也指控俄罗斯在效仿伊朗封锁黑海。

- 也门政府承诺不利用领土威胁邻国与海上安全，但胡塞武装的行动表明该组织仍在挑战国际航运。 [Yemeni government vows not to let territory threaten neighbors, maritime security - Anadolu Ajansı](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxQSFN0TXVqdy1zTndqN0JGTDBzRW5zMkFUTU5GT2syc3d0VHdIcTJOQzZkTkRmSktCdmduVTFXelljczc0SGlZdVI4OGlYRENSV0hoNWJnbVZpU0lsUWFLajlHQVZpZTBTaDlnb1V1djVlR3RYWlFsSThlTDRzbnBTWnRzTHY1Znl5X2NsaUFNMTlCVDRRRWx2RWxCc0VfYjlSaThhZlprRDlxcVBKRnNWdThaZXY5RkNoMkpCekRFX1c0LXc)
- 霍尔木兹海峡通航量较前一周骤降超一半，亚洲炼油商紧急寻找替代原油来源。 [Asian refiners look for alternative crude as Middle East prices rise - Baird Maritime](https://news.google.)
- 乌克兰外长西比哈指责俄罗斯采取与伊朗类似手段封锁黑海，航运安全进一步恶化。 [Russia is doing to Black Sea what Iran is doing to Strait of Hormuz - Sybiha - ukranews.com](https://news.google.)
- 英国皇家国际事务研究所（Chatham House）发文质疑：面对胡塞武装的封锁，集体海上安全体系能否被有效防御还是将崩溃。 [The Houthi Red Sea blockade: Will collective maritime security be defended, or break down? - Chatham House](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxPZTVHQWRucTNhcGFGMGJvRWttU2ZoNTFEeEcwMDNiMmtWYWVGSllJa0lrMWJvSDdBb2x5SEU3YkM4Q0hldjhmTUhhZVlGSjA3V1FUUy1LNl9lMHRpR2gybl9va0w0ZUZtanRJZUkwOEZwZHdJZnh5bFRiWHppakZfZzVZWkRDcmQtTmlRZkVXZmR0NUoxSjBrM0Jmc3hpanFfejg1ajVXZGlCWmpqVXNOYVpUT1N4ajF6TXdkXw)

**收束判断：** 霍尔木兹海峡的封锁正在从军事事件演变为全球经济危机，市场已开始定价“长期断供”风险。若冲突再持续一周，国际油价可能突破120美元，届时中东国家的政治算盘也将被迫调整。
冲突局势.en:
The conflict landscape is dominated by the convergence of three simultaneous maritime choke-point crises — the Strait of Hormuz, the Red Sea, and the Black Sea — driving oil prices toward $110 and forcing Asian refiners to scramble for alternative crude. Yemen's government has vowed not to let its territory threaten neighbors, but Houthi actions belie that pledge, with a renewed blockade against Saudi-linked shipping. The Iran war is described as a 'perma-crisis' by Al Arabiya, with both sides striking military sites.

- **Oil price shock**: Physical crude prices near $110 due to supply disruptions from Iran and Ukraine wars ([BOE Report](https://news.google.)).
- **Hormuz closure hits real economy**: Supermarket prices already rising due to Strait of Hormuz closure ([OilPrice.com](https://news.google.)).
- **US and Iran trade strikes**: Iran targets US strongholds around the Gulf; US hits more Iranian military sites ([Tribune-Democrat](https://news.google.)).
- **Russia parallels Hormuz**: Ukraine’s Foreign Minister Sybiha likens Russian Black Sea actions to Iran’s Hormuz blockade ([ukranews.com](https://news.google.)).

**Signal**: The multi-theater disruption of energy shipping is now a first-order economic threat; watch for coordinated naval responses or further escalation as insurance and freight costs spiral.

国际安全.zh:
**概览：** 美军持续在伊朗方向采取高压行动，同时乌克兰战场出现新的远程打击能力。美国中央司令部宣布在波斯湾摧毁一艘试图突破封锁的油轮，巴林首次确认其防空系统拦截了伊朗导弹。乌克兰则首次使用了荷兰提供的Ruta Block 1巡航导弹，标志着西方援乌武器从防御向进攻性远程精确打击的质变。

- 美军中央司令部称在波斯湾摧毁了一艘试图突破封锁的伊朗油轮，行动代号未公布。 [US forces disable tanker after blockade attempts, CENTCOM says - NewsNation](https://news.google.)
- 乌克兰防空部队声称击落一枚俄军“伊斯坎德尔”导弹和81架无人机，但俄军对基辅地区的白天导弹袭击仍造成10人死亡、近100人受伤。 [Russia and Ukraine exchanged punishing strikes Friday. Ballistic missiles ripped apart a defense industry exhibition outside Kyiv in a rare daytime attack, killing at least 10 people and injuring close to 100. - facebook.com](https://news.google.)
- 乌克兰使用荷兰Ruta Block 1巡航导弹的证据浮现，这是该导弹的首次实战，显示低成本、可大规模生产的远程打击能力正在重塑战场。 [Evidence Of Ukraine Using Dutch Ruta Block 1 Cruise Missiles Emerges - The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/evidence-of-ukraine-using-dutch-ruta-block-1-cruise-missiles-emerges)
- 德国国防部因看不到伊朗战争结束前景，撤回原定用于霍尔木兹海峡战后任务的两艘海军舰艇，欧洲盟友对冲突长期化的评估影响军事部署。 [With no Iran war end in sight, Germany pulls back two navy ships eyed for Hormuz mission - Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/07/24/with-no-iran-war-end-in-sight-germany-pulls-back-two-navy-ships-eyed-for-hormuz-mission/)

**收束判断：** 乌克兰获得荷兰巡航导弹与德国撤出霍尔木兹任务形成了鲜明对比：西方在援乌问题上加速“松绑”，但在中东却因持久战而收缩。这种差异化策略可能引发盟友间的不满，尤其东欧国家可能质疑德国对安全承诺的优先级。
国际安全.en:
International security headlines are dominated by the expanding US-Iran conflict, Ukraine's persistent long-range strikes, and technological developments in naval and air power. US forces disabled a tanker after blockade attempts, while Bahrain confirmed intercepting Iranian attacks. Ukraine continues to innovate with drone warfare and Dutch Ruta cruise missiles, while Russia retaliates with ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv. Defense industrial developments include Turkey's mass production phase, UK's Tempest demonstrator imagery, and the B-21 production ramp.

- **US disables tanker, Bahrain intercepts**: CENTCOM confirmed disabling a tanker after blockade attempts ([NewsNation](https://news.google.)). Bahrain says air defenses intercepted Iranian attacks ([Iran International](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUkFVX3lxTE04dXc0dEhBUkVrMlRzTm1LbFpSdUEwZ000SGRxYkFjc0M0eWhNWk1OSUZQdmdvVFZDSWpOeWstLURua2VZVmNmZVltWk0ycFhaS1E)).
- **Ukraine strikes deep**: A Ukrainian drone unit operating far behind the front line has hit over 180 vessels ([Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/07/24/from-steppe-to-sea-a-ukrainian-drone-unit-hunts-russian-ships)). Evidence emerges of Ukraine using Dutch Ruta Block 1 cruise missiles in combat ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/evidence-of-ukraine-using-dutch-ruta-block-1-cruise-missiles-emerges)).
- **Russia strikes Kyiv area**: Ballistic missiles hit a defense industry exhibition outside Kyiv, killing at least 10 and injuring nearly 100 ([Facebook](https://news.google.)). Ukrainian air defenses shot down one Iskander missile and 81 drones ([Ukrinform](https://news.google.)).
- **Defense tech advances**: UK reveals more images of its stealth fighter demonstrator for Tempest ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/more-of-the-uks-stealth-fighter-demonstrator-revealed-in-new-images)). US Coast Guard seeks technology to hunt and kill UUVs ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/sea/u-s-coast-guard-seeking-technology-to-hunt-and-kill-uncrewed-underwater-vehicles)). B-21 production ramp-up deal includes pathway to larger fleet ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/pathway-to-larger-b-21-raider-fleet-was-baked-into-production-ramp-up-deal)).

**Signal**: Ukraine's shift to mass-produced long-range strike capabilities and Russia's ballistic missile terror tactics are reshaping the battlefield; the US-Iran conflict is drawing in regional partners like Bahrain, while defense industrial base investments signal a long-term competition.

中国军情.zh:
**概览：** 南海紧张局势持续升级，中国与菲律宾在仁爱礁、黄岩岛等多点发生对峙，中国海警船连续两天发射水炮驱离菲公务船。美国、日本及十余国发表声明“搅局”，中国则通过王毅外长在马尼拉的讲话阐明底线。同时，五角大楼再度扩大“中国军事企业清单”，多所顶尖大学首次被纳入。

- 菲律宾指责中国海警船连续第二天对其公务船发射水炮，特朗普承诺将在与习近平通话时提及菲方关切。 [菲指责中方船只连续第二天对其公务船发射水炮 特朗普承诺将与习近平提及菲方关切 - RFI](https://news.google.)
- 中国海警局发言人就菲“多点生事、蓄意挑衅”发表谈话，强调中国海警依法维权。 [中国海警局新闻发言人就菲位南海多点生事、蓄意挑衅发表谈话 - peopleapp.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE01X2hfWldzM0xaa25OV1dNdllNZTlPS3plcHhESEJONUl3SVRCLUI5ZjZ4ckpsTzhsOVh1TWktSHU3VTNlWG9TNTFoYkE5TkdTYWdGUVFzRDNfOUlQMVFrOGM3SElMNXZh)
- 王毅在马尼拉举行记者会，阐述南海问题立场，称中国是地区“稳定性与确定性”，而域外势力搅局只会“让自己露怯”。 [大外交｜王毅的马尼拉时刻：阐明南海问题立场，展现中国“稳定性与确定性” - thepaper.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1YQU9jMXVtaF9KaWRtc2tZdV9ja1BFVlNHOXJ2WE5td1BaZDZzREpQVkNkOTZrTmxUdlhCaTlOUWVsRzBWWGdYcFNxcG10QWJQang5WS1xV3J0ZmEyNUE)
- 五角大楼扩大科研限制“黑名单”，中国多所顶尖大学首次上榜，包括此前未列入的理工类高校，中美科技脱钩进一步深化。 [五角大楼扩大科研限制“黑名单”，中国多所顶尖大学首次上榜 - 美国之音](https://news.google.)

**收束判断：** 南海对峙已从战术摩擦升级为中美外交博弈的一部分，特朗普承诺介入表明南海问题将进入新一轮“电话外交”周期。五角大楼扩大“黑名单”则表明美国对华科技压制正从企业延伸至学术机构，中国的高校国际合作将受到严重影响。
中国军情.en:
China's military posture in the South China Sea is increasingly confrontational, with multiple incidents involving Philippine vessels. Chinese state media accuse Japan and the Philippines of collusion, while the US expands its Pentagon blacklist to include several top Chinese universities. Foreign Minister Wang Yi's visit to Manila aims to assert Chinese stability and counter US influence. Taiwan's DPP is criticized for diverging from the national line on the South China Sea.

- **Philippine water cannon incident**: Philippines accuses Chinese vessels of firing water cannons for the second consecutive day; Trump pledges to raise the issue with Xi ([RFI](https://news.google.)).
- **Pentagon blacklist expanded**: US adds multiple top Chinese universities to research restriction list ([美国之音](https://news.google.)). US also adds some Chinese companies to 'Chinese military enterprise list', prompting Ministry of Commerce response ([财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTFBNNkFhZGRLZGRRLTdZQXJmUnkwSnFLNlRPWmhDMXd3WFN1R2tXa0dqTXhhcUJBdTExSEppOUpNZkg5a1AzS20xag)).
- **Wang Yi in Manila**: Chinese Foreign Minister clarifies South China Sea stance, presenting China as a force of 'stability and certainty' ([thepaper.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1YQU9jMXVtaF9KaWRtc2tZdV9ja1BFVlNHOXJ2WE5td1BaZDZzREpQVkNkOTZrTmxUdlhCaTlOUWVsRzBWWGdYcFNxcG10QWJQang5WS1xV3J0ZmEyNUE)).
- **Japan-Philippines collusion denounced**: Chinese media and official sources criticize Japan for hyping Taiwan Strait and South China Sea issues ([人民网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTFBHbklNd1dpYXAzVklRZ0t6UlNFcmNnZGFDaWVqZEd4a2cwSWhVTUw3VDFHMERZRzZuWGlLRDEzZWllLVdzZEtTdzFuV1VkUG40U05NZGxEX1NSbkhiSVUxZF9rLUlMLVZoaThDSA)).

**Signal**: The South China Sea is becoming a focal point of US-China competition; the water cannon incident and Trump's involvement indicate potential for direct presidential intervention. The Pentagon's expanding blacklist signals deepening tech decoupling.

海军与印太.zh:
**概览：** 美国海军加速采购低成本远程打击导弹，以应对霍尔木兹海峡等海上威胁。霍尔木兹海峡通航量跌至新低，胡塞武装在红海再次发动袭击。美国国内出现关于是否应允许在外国造船厂建造美军舰艇的争论，白宫强烈反对国会限制。与此同时，欧洲与亚洲的海军合作项目持续推进，反无人潜航器（UUV）技术成为新热点。

- 美国海军通过CHAOS项目采购低成本巡航导弹，旨在扩大舰队和盟友的远程海上打击能力，CoAspire公司成为中标方。 [U.S. Navy Orders Low-cost Missiles to Expand Fleet, Allied Long-Range Maritime Strike Capabilities - USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/24/u-s-navy-orders-low-cost-missiles-to-expand-fleet-allied-long-range-maritime-strike-capabilities)
- 霍尔木兹海峡上周通航量仅为78次（东西双向），较前一周174次骤降55%。胡塞武装重新对沙特关联船只实施封锁，红海安全状况恶化。 [Hormuz Transits Remain Low, Houthis Resume Attacks in Red Sea - USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/24/hormuz-transits-remain-low-houthis-resume-attacks-in-red-sea)
- 白宫反对2027财年国防授权法案中禁止购买外国建造军舰的条款，认为这将削弱海军快速补充能力。 [White House Protests Congressional Block on Buying Foreign Warships for U.S. Navy - USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/24/white-house-protests-congressional-block-on-buying-foreign-warships-for-u-s-navy)
- 美国海岸警卫队发布需求，寻求可猎杀无人潜航器（UUV）的技术。Ultra Maritime与Anduril在“Lanternfish”演习中成功演示了反UUV能力。 [U.S. Coast Guard Seeking Technology To Hunt And Kill Uncrewed Underwater Vehicles - The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/sea/u-s-coast-guard-seeking-technology-to-hunt-and-kill-uncrewed-underwater-vehicles)
- Saronic与三星重工宣布战略合作，共同开发自主能力海事系统，加速美国造船工业基础重建。 [Saronic and Samsung Heavy Industries Partner to Accelerate the Reindustrialization of American Shipbuilding in the Era of Autonomy - Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/saronic-and-samsung-heavy-industries-partner-to-accelerate-the-reindustrialization-of-american-shipbuilding-in-the-era-of-autonomy/)

**收束判断：** 霍尔木兹通航量暴跌已对全球供应链产生实质性影响，美国海军正从两方面应对：一是通过采购低成本导弹强化打击能力，二是通过国际合作（包括外国造船）弥补产能不足。白宫与国会在“买外国舰”问题上的分歧，反映出美国海军当前面临的战略焦虑：既要应对全球海上危机，又缺乏本土建造能力。反UUV技术加速部署则表明，水下无人威胁已从概念走向现实作战需求。
海军与印太.en:
Naval developments this week highlight a race for affordable long-range strike, a tightening of maritime security in the Middle East, and major European submarine partnerships. The US Navy's CHAOS program has selected CoAspire to provide low-cost cruise missiles for the fleet and allies. Hormuz transits remain critically low, while Houthis have resumed attacks in the Red Sea. The RIMPAC exercise is underway with USS Theodore Roosevelt leading a group sail. Meanwhile, TKMS and Navantia advance a strategic submarine partnership, and the White House pushes back against congressional restrictions on buying foreign warships.

- **CHAOS missile contract awarded**: US Navy selects CoAspire for the Coalition Heterogenous Affordable Offensive Strike program to deliver low-cost cruise missiles for allied maritime strike ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/24/u-s-navy-orders-low-cost-missiles-to-expand-fleet-allied-long-range-maritime-strike-capabilities)).
- **Hormuz transits plummet**: Lloyd's List tracks only 78 transits this week vs 174 the previous week; Houthis resume attacks against Saudi-linked shipping ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/24/hormuz-transits-remain-low-houthis-resume-attacks-in-red-sea)).
- **RIMPAC underway**: USS Theodore Roosevelt leads a group sail with partner forces in Hawaii as part of RIMPAC 2026 ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/24/usni-news-western-pacific-pulse-july-24-2026)).
- **White House vs Congress on foreign warships**: OMB opposes a House NDAA section blocking purchase of battle force ships from foreign yards ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/24/white-house-protests-congressional-block-on-buying-foreign-warships-for-u-s-navy)).
- **TKMS-Navantia partnership advances**: Second MoU signed aiming to establish a joint collaboration framework for submarine production and commercialization by year-end ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/tkms-and-navantia-advance-strategic-submarine-partnership-with-ambition-to-establish-joint-collaboration-framework-by-year-end/)).

**Signal**: The US Navy is hedging against high-cost munitions with a new low-cost strike capability, while the legislative battle over foreign-built warships will test the will to rebuild the US shipbuilding industrial base. The collapse of Hormuz traffic underscores the fragility of global energy supply chains.

科技产品.zh:
科技产品今日以政策博弈和公司战略调整为主线。特朗普威胁对欧盟关税以回应谷歌罚款（[Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2222963/trump-threatens-eu-with-new-tariffs-in-response-to-google-fine/)），将科技反垄断裁决直接政治化。Meta在用户反弹后暂停智能眼镜收费计划（[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/970970/after-backlash-meta-pauses-plan-to-rate-limit-its-smart-glasses)），但眼镜引发的隐私骚扰问题（同源报道）仍是一颗定时炸弹。SpaceX星舰V3发射成功但助推器再次失利（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/24/spacex-launches-new-v3-starlink-satellites-but-suffers-another-booster-failure/)），重复使用能力的可靠性仍存疑。Nothing确认裁员但否认退出12个市场（[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/970848/nothing-layoffs-rumors-phone-4b)），手机市场收缩压力可见一斑。

**收束**：硬件厂商在政策与市场双重压力下频繁调整，产品创新之外，合规与公共关系已成生存关键。
科技产品.en:
The product desk is dominated by regulatory showdowns, operational setbacks, and corporate pivots. Trump's tariff threat in response to the EU's Google fine could escalate transatlantic trade friction, while Meta's retreat on smart glasses fees doesn't erase mounting privacy concerns. SpaceX's Starship milestone is undercut by a booster failure, and a wildfire near Madrid threatens NASA's deep space communications. Nothing's layoffs and market exit denials add to the uncertainty.

- [Trump threatens EU with new tariffs in response to Google fine](https://www.engadget.com/2222963/trump-threatens-eu-with-new-tariffs-in-response-to-google-fine/) — The EU's Digital Markets Act enforcement against Google triggers a US tariff threat, potentially affecting a wide range of tech goods.
- [After backlash, Meta pauses plan to ‘rate limit’ its smart glasses](https://www.theverge.com/tech/970970/after-backlash-meta-pauses-plan-to-rate-limit-its-smart-glasses) — Meta drops a $20/month subscription for a local feature, but the device remains a source of privacy incidents with 'pranking' going viral.
- [SpaceX launches new V3 Starlink satellites but suffers another booster failure](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/24/spacex-launches-new-v3-starlink-satellites-but-suffers-another-booster-failure/) — The 13th Starship test flight delivered 20 V3 satellites but again failed to relight the booster, clouding reusability progress.
- [Wildfire forces evacuation of NASA's Deep Space Network complex in Spain](https://arstechnica.com/space/2026/07/wildfire-forces-evacuation-of-nasas-deep-space-network-complex-in-spain/) — A wildfire threatened the Madrid deep space communications site; damage assessment is pending as the emergency continues.
- [Nothing confirms layoffs, but calls market exit rumors ‘fake news’](https://www.theverge.com/tech/970848/nothing-layoffs-rumors-phone-4b) — Nothing is laying off staff and reorganizing, but denies reports of exiting 12 markets or weak Phone 4B sales.

**Signal:** The intersection of geopolitics and tech regulation will likely create supply chain disruptions; monitor how tariffs and natural disasters impact hardware availability.

HackNews社区动态.zh:
社区技术讨论热度高企，同时政治干预数字平台再次引发关注。Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY的可扩展性测试获238分（[DBOS](https://www.dbos.dev/blog/postgres-listen-notify-scalability)），为实时应用开发者提供了重要参考。印度政府以安全为由要求GitHub移除蓝牙聊天应用Bitchat（[The Hindu](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/government-orders-github-to-remove-bluetooth-based-chat-app-bitchat-over-security-concerns-jack-dorsey/article71262049.ece)），获408分高热度讨论，凸显去中心化通讯工具与主权审查的持续张力。另一热门视频《Don't Take the Black Pill》（[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zLZwpH5lCD4)）引发151分讨论，反映硅谷悲观心态的反思。

**收束**：社区既拥抱技术突破（如Postgres扩展），也直面言论与安全的边界问题。
HackNews社区动态.en:
Hacker News saw lively discussions around government intervention in open-source code, technical scalability, and novel hardware. The takedown order for the Bluetooth chat app Bitchat sparked a fierce debate on censorship and decentralized communication, while a technical post on Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY scalability garnered high engagement. New projects like Gsxui for Go and biological discoveries about sperm whale sleep also captured attention.

- [Government orders GitHub to remove Bluetooth-based chat app Bitchat: Jack Dorsey](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/government-orders-github-to-remove-bluetooth-based-chat-app-bitchat-over-security-concerns-jack-dorsey/article71262049.ece) — With 408 points and 297 comments, the removal of Bitchat over security concerns ignited discussion on platform governance and government overreach.
- [Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY actually scales](https://www.dbos.dev/blog/postgres-listen-notify-scalability) — A deep dive showing Postgres's notification system can handle high throughput, earning 238 points and 43 comments.
- [Show HN: Gsxui – Shadcn-style components for Go](https://ui.gsxhq.dev/) — A new UI library for Go developers inspired by Shadcn, with 58 points and 8 comments, indicating interest in Go frontend tooling.
- [Sperm Whales blow bubbles to achieve restful, vertical sleep](https://news.st-andrews.ac.uk/archive/sperm-whales-blow-bubbles-to-achieve-restful-vertical-sleep/) — A surprising biological discovery with 55 points, offering insight into marine mammal behavior.
- [Unitree As2-W](https://www.unitree.com/As2-W/) — The latest humanoid robot from Unitree gathered 108 points and 41 comments, reflecting ongoing enthusiasm for robotics.

**Signal:** The Bitchat takedown is a key test case for government authority over code hosting; watch for similar actions and community responses.

AI.zh:
AI领域进入“效率优先”与“监管博弈”的新阶段。Anthropic Opus 5登顶Artificial Analysis排行榜（[Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/07/anthropics-opus-5-is-about-token-efficiency-not-a-capability-leap/)），其核心优势是token效率而非能力跃升，表明业界转向成本竞争力。中国Kimi K3则加剧了硅谷对监管路线的分歧（[Google News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTFB1em14V2wxUDdRSXBJU2o1ZUdkYW4tNjJQZHV2dV9qSVZCRng3MTNDSjRQVXRqeDVPOVFoT1NuQ0JxYWtNU3dfUENDQzVVUkk0YkJlbURLdmtHQ05weEFfeTRLQ0szYVJtTjU0)）。DeepMind负责人公开呼吁华盛顿支持全球AI监管机构（[Los Angeles Times](https://news.google.)），安全担忧成焦点。Midjourney收购占星App Co-Star（[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/970894/midjourney-co-star-acquisition)），预示AI公司从工具向文化消费延伸。Cognition收购Poke强调AI个性竞争力（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/24/why-cognition-bought-poke-ai-personality-is-becoming-a-competitive-advantage/)），交互风格已成差异化要素。

**收束**：AI竞赛从“更大模型”转向“更便宜、更人性化”，同时中美监管裂痕加深，全球治理框架亟待建立。
AI.en:
AI news this cycle is split between model efficiency breakthroughs, geopolitical regulatory pressure, and cultural integration moves. China's Kimi K3 model is deepening the Silicon Valley divide on regulation, with DeepMind's chief urging a global watchdog. Anthropic's Opus 5 tops the leaderboard but its main advance is token efficiency, not raw capability. New lab Prentis (co-founded by Reid Hoffman and Mark Pincus) is raising $100M to automate routine computer tasks, while Midjourney's acquisition of astrology app Co-Star signals a push into consumer culture. AlphaFold's role in redesigning gene-editing proteins for safety highlights AI's expanding impact in biotech.

- [China’s Kimi K3 Exposes a Growing Divide in Silicon Valley Over AI Regulation](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTFB1em14V2wxUDdRSXBJU2o1ZUdkYW4tNjJQZHV2dV9qSVZCRng3MTNDSjRQVXRqeDVPOVFoT1NuQ0JxYWtNU3dfUENDQzVVUkk0YkJlbURLdmtHQ05weEFfeTRLQ0szYVJtTjU0) — The model's rise intensifies calls for a global AI watchdog; DeepMind chief urges Washington to back it.
- [Anthropic's Opus 5 is about token efficiency, not a capability leap](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/07/anthropics-opus-5-is-about-token-efficiency-not-a-capability-leap/) — Opus 5 leads the leaderboard but the key improvement is lower cost, making advanced AI more accessible for routine tasks.
- [Prentis, new AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman, Mark Pincus in talks to raise $100M](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/24/prentis-new-ai-lab-co-founded-by-reid-hoffman-mark-pincus-in-talks-to-raise-100m/) — The lab focuses on automating mundane computer tasks, betting that AI's biggest use case is beyond coding.
- [Midjourney bought the astrology app Co-Star](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/970894/midjourney-co-star-acquisition) — Midjourney expands into personalized astrology, blending AI with consumer culture and signaling a push beyond image generation.
- [Team uses AlphaFold AI to redesign gene-editing proteins to make them safer](https://arstechnica.com/science/2026/07/team-uses-alphafold-ai-to-redesign-gene-editing-proteins-to-make-them-safer/) — AlphaFold identifies error-prone regions in gene-editing proteins, potentially leading to safer CRISPR therapies.

**Signal:** The AI arms race is shifting from raw intelligence to efficiency and application; expect regulatory frameworks to emerge and cultural integration to accelerate.

汽车.zh:
汽车行业电动化与资本交织，争议与突破并存。特斯拉CEO马斯克宣称开源Model S/X，但此前Roadster的开源仅放出少量文件且无正式许可（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/24/tesla-open-source-model-s-x-roadster-release-audit/)），诚意遭质疑。BYD确认全新旗舰轿车续航达1008公里（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/24/byd-confirms-new-flagship-ev-range-1008-km-video/)），巩固领先地位。奥迪A2 EV定位亲民，续航超400英里（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/24/audis-most-affordable-ev-revealed-400-miles-range-video/)），欧洲传统品牌加速反攻。Honda取消唯一在美电动车后竟建议Prologue车主改买混动车（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/24/after-canceling-evs-honda-laughably-tells-ev-owners-to-buy-a-gas-guzzler-instead/)），反映其电动战略混乱。小鹏重返澳大利亚推五款新车，瞄准德系豪华（[Google News](https://news.google.)），中国品牌出海路线分化。

**收束**：电动车企进入淘汰赛，续航竞赛与战略摇摆者并存；开源承诺需兑现力，消费者用脚投票。
汽车.en:
The EV sector is buzzing with new models and contrasting corporate strategies. Tesla's promise to open source Model S and X is met with skepticism after a weak prior release. Audi and BYD push range boundaries with the affordable A2 (over 400 miles) and flagship sedan (1,008 km) respectively. Honda's retreat from EVs, advising owners to buy a hybrid, highlights a strategic divergence. A massive solar farm rising at a Texas coal site underscores the messy energy transition.

- [Musk says Tesla to ‘open source’ Model S and X, but prior release makes us skeptical](https://electrek.co/2026/07/24/tesla-open-source-model-s-x-roadster-release-audit/) — Tesla's claim is undercut by the Roadster 'open source' release that was just eight files with no license.
- [Audi’s most affordable EV revealed with over 400 miles of range](https://electrek.co/2026/07/24/audis-most-affordable-ev-revealed-400-miles-range-video/) — The A2 electric car promises over 400 miles of range, positioning it as a strong competitor in the affordable segment.
- [BYD’s new flagship EV breaks cover for the first time with a range of 1,008 km](https://electrek.co/2026/07/24/byd-confirms-new-flagship-ev-range-1008-km-video/) — BYD's upcoming flagship sedan sets a new range benchmark, intensifying the EV range war.
- [After canceling EVs, Honda laughably tells EV owners to buy a gas guzzler instead](https://electrek.co/2026/07/24/after-canceling-evs-honda-laughably-tells-ev-owners-to-buy-a-gas-guzzler-instead/) — Honda's cancellation of its only US EV and advice to Prologue owners to consider a hybrid highlights its retreat from electrification.
- [A 1.2 GW solar farm is rising at a Texas coal site – but coal is staying](https://electrek.co/2026/07/24/a-1-2-gw-solar-farm-is-rising-at-a-texas-coal-site-but-coal-is-staying/) — A massive solar project is built alongside a coal plant, illustrating the complex and slow energy transition.

**Signal:** The EV market is polarizing between ambitious range claims and strategic pullbacks; Tesla's open source follow-through and Honda's hybrid pivot will shape consumer sentiment.

足球.zh:
足坛今日聚焦三件事：曼城中场核心罗德里确认接受背部手术，新帅马雷斯卡直面核心伤病难题；德国队新帅克洛普首秀即对媒体发出辞职威胁，强调家庭隐私底线；AC米兰计划出售托莫里与奇克筹款3000万欧元，为夏季引援腾挪空间。此外，拜仁官方辟谣穆西亚拉被推荐至加拉塔萨雷的传闻，确认其重要性。

- **[罗德里手术影响曼城中轴](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c36dw0nwexxo)**：世界冠军中场长期缺阵将考验马雷斯卡的变阵能力，曼城可能被迫在转会市场紧急寻找替代者。
- **[克洛普威胁辞职：媒体别碰我家人](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cqjxd0n4gd2o)**：德国足协发布会上的强硬表态引发舆论分裂，部分媒体批评其过度反应，也有声音力挺主帅立规矩。
- **[米兰为引援欲卖托莫里+奇克](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTFB0c1VUY0lweFR2UVR1SWtGdW1PajRMaDM2X1R6bFB1VUpNRDRseG9tWF81X2hKUzg1MzFod0ZLVFZmSFJGc09WUHF6OTh0NFhPLVhnek1R)**：红黑军团希望套现换取资金，但两名球员均非冗余，此举可能削弱防线与中场深度。
- **[拜仁确认穆西亚拉为非卖品](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTFBFSVpqeHNZYWJPQ1FVT2tqUzFsc1M2azlCQXFJa2pmWVI4bXN1MG5hQ1pHR1E4NzZ5dkhpLVpHeGFYYXYxS3hYQXpRZnQxMnEtTnE3Nm9B)**：法尔克记者曝出虚假推荐传闻，拜仁高层迅速回应，稳定军心。

收束：欧洲转会窗进入深水区，伤病与清洗并行，豪门阵型重塑正在加速。
足球.en:
The 'football' desk aggregated a wide array of sports news, including darts, gymnastics, swimming, cricket, F1, cycling, boxing, rugby league, and golf. However, genuine football stories centered on two off-field developments: Rodri's back surgery and Jurgen Klopp's early controversy with the German media. The Rodri injury could be a critical blow to Manchester City's midfield depth as the new season approaches, while Klopp's public ultimatum to the press sets an adversarial tone for his tenure as Germany head coach.

- [Rodri to have back surgery but Maresca brushes off transfer speculation](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c36dw0nwexxo) — The World Cup winner's recovery timeline remains unclear, but City's new boss insists the club is not rushing into the transfer market.
- [Klopp starts Germany reign by threatening to quit](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cqjxd0n4gd2o) — Jurgen Klopp warned he would resign if media intrusions into his family's privacy continue, creating immediate friction ahead of Germany's upcoming friendlies.
- [Hamilton fastest as new Aston Martin makes encouraging debut](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/formula1/articles/c3v0wp9yvdgo) — Though non-football, this F1 headline was filed under football; Ferrari's pace at the Hungaroring suggests a tightening constructors' battle.
- [Pogacar on verge of fifth Tour title after Alpe d'Huez win](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/cycling/articles/c2elrwxe941o) — Also filed under football, cycling's biggest story of the day: Pogacar's fifth Tour title is all but sealed.
- [Fury wins low-key warm-up to keep Joshua fight on track](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/boxing/articles/cy5dnnq1l0po) — Filed under football, the heavyweight boxing narrative continues with Fury calling out Joshua's courage.

**Signal:** The desk's miscategorization highlights a broader data quality issue, but the key football takeaways are Rodri's surgery risk and Klopp's early power play.

篮球.zh:
NBA最大新闻无疑是勒布朗·詹姆斯以41岁高龄加盟费城76人，宣布将是生涯最后一份合同，东部争冠版图瞬间重构。CBA方面，广东宏远总经理朱芳雨正式离任，其未来转型引发热议；南京同曦签下杜润旺与李玮颢，继续补强本土阵容。

- **[詹姆斯加盟76人：最后一份合同](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/articles/cx27r0me3zno)**：勒布朗选择联手恩比德与马克西，目标直指总冠军，76人瞬间成为下赛季最大夺冠热门之一。
- **[朱芳雨离任广东宏远总经理](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5FUlhkSk1sSE5zblcwZnMtMHJLWWx0bFVFM1FiV05SSTR2ZndWbjhjdnVKTlVWS2F1d0NYVlNtbnRvdkJCZ1llNm1ibDYxVGNSQTF5a0VySlpib0RubVZyaGw2QQ)**：宏远功勋在球队重建期选择离开，广东球迷社区一片哗然，其未来是否转型解说员成为新话题。
- **[同曦正式签约杜润旺、李玮颢](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxOM3V0NERZb1haTjBicmRSZnVuRUoydmhOVkNlTkF2S3pfV2l5eDEyRUdBVVhwT2g4R3ZSTVZNbDFtaEFSS1JTZE5EVU12UDBueEE4aU43VS1sZjl4UkNvdzNNWm1MUDJNQTR4QjA0NGNvUEFnVTRaM0NBWjlwTkNCVGZpdVY)**：这两位国手级锋线加盟，显著提升同曦侧翼深度，新赛季CBA竞争格局再添变数。
- **[NBA球星来CBA利弊讨论再起](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE8wY3hHdkk2dmU2U25OYVIzbjNXa2NrNzN3Y1NoNmFxaXFIeHdReVNtaVo2NDBTLU5aakIyYmZ3aV9Pc2NGLVdyUGVJcV9UM0w5U3d5NGdKOTVHM3NmODZhNktYOA)**：随着詹姆斯远赴费城，CBA引入顶级外援的利弊再次被媒体热议，官方或需平衡资金扶持与竞争公平。

收束：勒布朗的决定将引发NBA权力东移，CBA则在管理层变动与人员流动中迎来新的赛季预热。
篮球.en:
Basketball headlines were dominated by a seismic free-agency move: LeBron James, at 41, announced he will join the Philadelphia 76ers for what he calls his final NBA contract. This instantly reshapes the title picture and sparks debates about his legacy. Domestically, Chinese basketball saw front-office changes with Zhu Fangyu stepping down as Guangdong Southern Tigers general manager, and the Nanjing Tongxi team signing Du Runwang and Li Weihao.

- [NBA superstar James, 41, to join Philadelphia 76ers](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/articles/cx27r0me3zno) — LeBron's departure from the Lakers to the 76ers creates a new superteam alongside Joel Embiid and Tyrese Maxey, with championship-or-bust expectations.
- [朱芳雨离任总经理](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5FUlhkSk1sSE5zblcwZnMtMHJLWWx0bFVFM1FiV05SSTR2ZndWbjhjdnVKTlVWS2F1d0NYVlNtbnRvdkJCZ1llNm1ibDYxVGNSQTF5a0VySlpib0RubVZyaGw2QQ) — Zhu Fangyu's departure as Guangdong GM marks a significant transition for one of CBA's most successful franchises, possibly leading to a new front-office philosophy.
- [同曦官方：球队已经正式和杜润旺&李玮颢完成签约](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxOM3V0NERZb1haTjBicmRSZnVuRUoydmhOVkNlTkF2S3pfV2l5eDEyRUdBVVhwT2g4R3ZSTVZNbDFtaEFSS1JTZE5EVU12UDBueEE4aU43VS1sZjl4UkNvdzNNWm1MUDJNQTR4QjA0NGNvUEFnVTRaM0NBWjlwTkNCVGZpdVY) — Nanjing Tongxi strengthened their roster with two domestic players, signaling an aggressive rebuild for the upcoming CBA season.
- [丹尼-格林：作为第三选择夺冠并不会让人们觉得詹姆斯是Goat](https://news.google.com/rules/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE1PXzlfa1dBeWlSOW43UHpxZlJ5bmZfUGRHaC1RWlBIVlRLS21LV185UTVaaF9DYVp2bUNUSmdOa1lFT002UUxLYUVjcFFzRG1HR2xhSHN3) (from 虎扑 community, but relevant to NBA discourse) — Danny Green's comment adds fuel to the GOAT debate as LeBron's move to a team where he may be a second or third option could test legacy narratives.

**Signal:** The LeBron-to-Philly move overshadows all other basketball news; expect intense analysis of cap implications and chemistry fit in the coming days.

羽毛球.zh:
2026年中国羽毛球公开赛四分之一决赛战罢，国羽女单表现强势，陈雨菲逆转因达农、王祉怡连胜韩国主力，携手韩悦占据四强两席，与日本队平分秋色。男单则遭遇重创，头号种子石宇奇与翁泓阳双双出局，国羽卫冕梦碎。

- **[陈雨菲2-1复仇因达农，晋级四强](https://news.google.)**：陈雨菲在首局失利后连扳两局，展现顽强韧性，为去年世锦赛失利复仇。
- **[石宇奇、翁泓阳止步八强，国羽男单无缘卫冕](https://news.google.)**：翁泓阳0-2不敌林俊易，石宇奇状态低迷，国羽男单整体厚度不足的问题再度暴露。
- **[王祉怡连胜韩国两大主力，静候韩悦](https://news.google.)**：王祉怡以2-0干净利落击败苦主，为国羽女单四强席位再添保障。
- **[女单四强中日各占两席，韩悦将战山口茜](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTFBMZm5fZ3VVdkw3d1AwbXI2eXNXbVJPZFNzVkx5em1NU1dzdzcybFNQU0NDbnVMbmpQMkNKM0NRZ21QdDB4VFFKM2FrdU1tdGhvQWJIbjlFdEllUExqTGJreHl1OEF3ZFhhTW9hZnNKU2pKMTJR)**：中日女单对决进入白热化，韩悦能否爆冷山口茜成为半决赛最大悬念。

收束：国羽女单延续强势，但男单断层危机已不容回避，后备人才培养迫在眉睫。
羽毛球.en:
The 2026 China Badminton Open quarterfinals delivered a day of mixed fortunes for the host nation.
