China's women's singles showed depth with three semifinalists — Chen Yufei, Wang Zhiyi, and Han Yue — occupying half the final four alongside Japanese opponents. However, the men's singles saw disappointment as top seed Shi Yuqi and Weng Hongyang both exited, ending China's hopes of defending the title. Doubles pairs Liang Weikeng/Wang Chang and Liu Shengshu/Tan Ning advanced strongly.

- [中国公开赛：国羽占据女单四强半壁江山！陈雨菲2-1复仇前世界第一](https://news.google.) — Chen Yufei's come-from-behind win over former world champion Ratchanok Intanon was a highlight, setting up a semifinal clash.
- [中国公开赛：2大男单止步八强！翁泓阳0-2林俊易，国羽无缘卫冕](https://news.google.) — Shi Yuqi's loss to a lower-ranked opponent was the biggest upset, ending China's title defense in the men's singles.
- [中国羽毛球公开赛：女单四强中日各占半壁江山](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTFBMZm5fZ3VVdkw3d1AwbXI2eXNXbVJPZFNzVkx5em1NU1dzdzcybFNQU0NDbnVMbmpQMkNKM0NRZ21QdDB4VFFKM2FrdU1tdGhvQWJIbjlFdEllUExqTGJreHl1OEF3ZFhhTW9hZnNKU2pKMTJR) — The semifinal lineup features three Chinese and one Japanese (Akane Yamaguchi), promising a competitive balance.

**Signal:** China's women's singles resurgence is the story of the tournament, but the men's singles collapse raises questions about depth ahead of the Asian Games.

虎扑社区动态.zh:
虎扑社区今日热议话题多元：丹尼·格林关于詹姆斯Goat地位的言论引发论战；湖人旧将阵容被调侃为“76人下赛季阵容”；德国国脚劳姆跨界发布单曲引关注；斯诺克小将常冰玉完胜宾汉姆；王楚钦赛后自责称未做到应做的；此外，米兰转会、穆西亚拉流言及电竞赛事积分榜均有讨论。

- **[丹尼·格林：作为第三选择夺冠无法证明詹姆斯是Goat](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE1PXzlfa1dBeWlSOW43UHpxZlJ5bmZfUGRHaC1RWlBIVlRLS21LV185UTVaaF9DYVp2bUNUSmdOa1lFT002UUxLYUVjcFFzRG1HR2xhSHN3)**：前队友这番言论直接冲击勒布朗历史地位的论据，社区内部分成两派激烈辩论。
- **[热媒晒湖人12-13赛季阵容：这就是76人下赛季的阵容](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE9MODF6cWk1ckxTZFhCX0xXdEt4dVdpcjd3cFc4cnZvbm8yU09Hc1poMzJudnNiamx4V0p5TUtqRXdFM0ZUQzhYVHhhdUc0cVZmbGVYNGln)**：将詹姆斯加盟与当年湖人F4类比，调侃76人纸面实力但暗指磨合风险，虎扑用户纷纷玩梗。
- **[德国国脚劳姆发布个人单曲，化身DJ ROOMER](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE1KUHJRX0h1Nk50aVZEaXBfTm9Ua1ByU3FTRUYzaU5FU1JtVHAxZmlETlZaOUN6amZ0SlVxeWJQOVdTY1ZEZEdlUHFITlJTcFBWNFh2V1dn)**：职业球员跨界音乐圈再添一例，评论区调侃“不高兴当球员了就去打碟”。
- **[常冰玉4-0完胜宾汉姆，晋级斯诺克英国公开赛正赛](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTFBCNm9RQldqYU03OGNtVEFPVk82M2xBOXotNk53LWMxSldmZHV3bk9FR1JEQXo1WWcycENETm1wRGUtMF9rT0ZwVUV2NG1sZXdnYmZTRnVn)**：中国小将零封前世锦赛冠军，展现惊人潜力，台球论坛热议其未来前途。
- **[王楚钦：几个队友都非常给力，我没做到应该做的](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE95eXpIYWtSZ3ZUWVcya1FjaXNzazFnZlRHVmk0RlF2VTlYR21Uc3V5aEVhOFMtNTdlRUlYaXd4OGs5QU92ZE9BYTFqWFFRNkNuZ3JIaVZhVkFKRUU0RGIzV0E5RzByNFBZNWJtXzhlM0Frdw)**：国乒主力在赛后主动揽责，社区对其谦逊态度点赞，同时也讨论团队比赛中的心态问题。

收束：虎扑今日讨论横跨篮球、足球、斯诺克、乒乓球等多个领域，球迷注意力分散但争议性话题（如詹姆斯Goat之争）依然是流量核心。
虎扑社区动态.en:
The Hu Pu community buzzed with a mix of hot-take NBA debates, European football transfer rumors, and esports standings. Key discussions included Danny Green's controversial take on LeBron James' legacy, AC Milan's potential fire sale to raise funds, and a creative social media post comparing the 76ers' new roster to the 2012-13 Lakers. Esports fans tracked the VCT CN standings and a PUBG Mobile leaderboard update.

- [丹尼-格林：作为第三选择夺冠并不会让人们觉得詹姆斯是Goat](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE1PXzlfa1dBeWlSOW43UHpxZlJ5bmZfUGRHaC1RWlBIVlRLS21LV185UTVaaF9DYVp2bUNUSmdOa1lFT002UUxLYUVjcFFzRG1HR2xhSHN3) — Danny Green's comment ignited a fierce GOAT debate among users, especially relevant after LeBron's 76ers announcement.
- [隆戈：米兰想卖托莫里+奇克换取3000万欧元，为引援筹集资金](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTFB0c1VUY0lweFR2UVR1SWtGdW1PajRMaDM2X1R6bFB1VUpNRDRseG9tWF81X2hKUzg1MzFod0ZLVFZmSFJGc09WUHF6OTh0NFhPLVhnek1R) — AC Milan's plan to sell Fikayo Tomori and Ruben Loftus-Cheek for €30M signals a budget constraint that could impact their Serie A campaign.
- [何意味？热媒晒湖人12-13赛季阵容：这就是76人下赛季的阵容](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE9MODF6cWk1ckxTZFhCX0xXdEt4dVdpcjd3cFc4cnZvbm8yU09Hc1poMzJudnNiamx4V0p5TUtqRXdFM0ZUQzhYVHhhdUc0cVZmbGVYNGln) — A viral post mocked the 76ers' perceived lack of depth by comparing them to the failed Lakers superteam, generating heavy engagement.
- [7月24日积分榜：Crab狂砍48淘汰豪取榜一，STE/4AM分列2/3](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE1NZG1DMTJybnEwaVpfS3d0bWpfc3IwT29sMnZpbjVIM2l4WC05bXB3cExtYk9lV1VGeGZ5dEZ2SzgyeWhmR3ExcTR0alh2THNycWt6Y1d3) — In PUBG Mobile, Crab's dominant 48 eliminations performance reshuffled the leaderboard, with implications for tournament seeding.

**Signal:** The community is heavily focused on NBA trade fallout and football transfer speculation, with esports posts drawing niche but passionate followings.

欧美.zh:
好莱坞在文化与商业的双重震荡中寻找锚点。吉尔莫·德尔·托罗在SDCC上明确拒绝AI介入《潘神的迷宫》重映，呼应了创作界对技术取代的深切忧虑。与此同时，特朗普在晚宴上对媒体的炮轰与《侠探杰克》演员的激进言论形成戏剧性对峙——白宫紧急为总统辩护，娱乐明星的政治发声正在引发更直接的反制。商业层面，派拉蒙与WB合并案因法律阻挠而股价承压，Kalshi起诉Netflix诽谤则揭示出新兴金融产品与传统影视叙事的冲突：预告片是否构成误导，将成为内容审核的新边界。
- [特朗普在记者晚宴上自嘲“特朗普精神错乱”，娱乐与政治边界模糊](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/trump-white-house-correspondents-dinner-remarks-1236820779/)
- [吉尔莫·德尔·托罗：重映版‘绝对没有AI’，保护艺术血统](https://deadline.com/2026/07/guillermo-del-toro-no-goddmn-ai-pans-labyrinth-re-release-1237003272/)
- [Kalshi对Netflix发出律师函，指控预告片虚假暗示违反法庭禁令](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/kalshi-netflix-defamation-trailer-prediction-markets-1236656342/)
- [派拉蒙-WBD合并案获延迟，股价盘后下滑](https://deadline.com/2026/07/paramount-wbd-merger-antitrust-lawsuit-delay-reactions-1237003045/)
- [BLACKPINK《DDU-DU DDU-DU》成为首支突破24亿观看量的K-pop组合MV](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857250wpp/blackpinks-ddu-du-ddu-du-becomes-1st-k-pop-group-mv-ever-to-hit-2-4-billion-views)

整体来看，欧美娱乐市场正被政治撕裂与科技伦理的拉锯主导，短期不确定性加剧。
欧美.en:
The Western entertainment desk is dominated by legal and industry shake-ups. Kalshi's defamation threat against Netflix over a prediction market documentary trailer signals a new front in content liability. Meanwhile, the Paramount-WBD merger faces a legal delay that sent stocks sliding, and Guillermo del Toro's Comic-Con panel made a strong anti-AI statement. Trump's White House Correspondents' Dinner speech blended politics and entertainment, while BLACKPINK's YouTube milestone shows global fandom power.

- **Kalshi vs. Netflix**: Kalshi's cease-and-desist accuses Netflix of misleadingly suggesting the company violated a court order in the trailer for 'The Prediction Games' [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/kalshi-threatens-netflix-misleading-prediction-market-doc-1237003123/).
- **Paramount-WBD Delay**: California AG secured a pledge not to close the merger before June 1, causing after-hours stock declines for both companies [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/paramount-wbd-merger-antitrust-lawsuitt-delay-reactions-1237003045/).
- **Del Toro's AI Stance**: At Comic-Con, the director emphasized that the 3D conversion of 'Pan's Labyrinth' relies on traditional techniques, vowing no AI involvement [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/guillermo-del-toro-no-ai-pans-labyrinth-rerelease-1236815109/).
- **Trump at WHCD**: The President used the dinner to attack media, calling it the largest group of 'Trump Derangement Syndrome' people ever assembled [Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/general-news/trump-white-house-correspondents-dinner-roasts-media-1236656443/).
- **BLACKPINK's 2.4B Views**: The milestone cements their place as a global pop phenomenon, with the MV surpassing 2.4 billion views on YouTube [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857250wpp/blackpinks-ddu-du-ddu-du-becomes-1st-k-pop-group-mv-ever-to-hit-2-4-billion-views).

Expect continued fallout from the Kalshi-Netflix dispute and the Paramount-WBD merger proceedings to dominate business headlines.

日韩.zh:
韩剧市场进入收官与开播的交替期：SBS《特工金重启》以收视第一的姿态迎来大结局，其谍战动作题材在竞争档期中保持强势。tvN新剧《Our Sticky Love》放出主海报和预告，由河英与丁海寅主演，失忆检察官与拳击教练的设定试图复制浪漫喜剧成功公式。此外，《Flex x Cop 2》加入新反派刘承昊，预告显示该剧将延续财阀侦探的爽感路线。品牌声誉方面，BTS连续多个月蝉联7月歌手品牌评价榜首，巩固其不可撼动的市场地位。
- [《特工金重启》大结局前收视稳居第一](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857257wpp/agent-kim-reactivated-heads-into-finale-on-no-1-ratings)
- [《Our Sticky Love》发布海报预告，河英×丁海寅开启可疑爱情](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857228wpp/watch-ha-young-and-jung-hae-ins-questionable-romance-begins-to-feel-real-in-our-sticky-love)
- [《Flex x Cop 2》新预告：安普贤与郑恩彩对决刘承昊](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857205wpp/watch-ahn-bo-hyun-and-jung-eun-chae-take-on-new-villain-yoo-seung-ho-and-a-string-of-brutal-crimes-in-flex-x-cop-2)
- [BTS高居7月歌手品牌声誉榜首](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857254wpp/july-singer-brand-reputation-rankings-announced-7)

韩娱在稳定输出内容的同时，品牌价值数据进一步验证了头部集团的马太效应。
日韩.en:
Korean and Japanese entertainment this cycle focuses on drama ratings and brand reputation. 'Agent Kim Reactivated' is heading into its finale with strong No.1 ratings, while BTS tops the July singer brand reputation rankings. Several K-dramas release new teasers, including 'Our Sticky Love' and 'Flex x Cop 2', indicating a busy second half of the year for K-content.

- **'Agent Kim Reactivated' Finale**: The SBS action drama maintained its lead with penultimate episode ratings, suggesting a strong finish [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857257wpp/agent-kim-reactivated-heads-into-finale-on-no-1-ratings).
- **BTS Leads Singer Rankings**: The Korean Business Research Institute ranked BTS first for July, reflecting sustained media coverage and fan interaction [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857254wpp/july-singer-brand-reputation-rankings-announced-7).
- **New Drama Teasers**: 'Our Sticky Love' released a main poster and trailer featuring Ha Young and Jung Hae In, while 'Flex x Cop 2' introduced a new villain played by Yoo Seung Ho [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857228wpp/watch-ha-young-and-jung-hae-ins-questionable-romance-begins-to-feel-real-in-our-sticky-love), [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857205wpp/watch-ahn-bo-hyun-and-jung-eun-chae-take-on-new-villain-yoo-seung-ho-and-a-string-of-brutal-crimes-in-flex-x-cop-2).
- **C-Drama Power Couples Article**: Soompi highlighted six period C-drama couples, tapping into cross-border Chinese-Korean interest [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856362wpp/6-power-couples-in-period-c-dramas-who-proved-they-were-better-together).

Watch for 'Agent Kim Reactivated' finale ratings and the August comeback of ALPHA DRIVE ONE as key metrics of fan engagement.

中国.zh:
国内娱乐板块呈现出冰火两重天：一边是猫眼娱乐预警上半年亏损，中国电影票房同期下跌四成，暑期档虽有所反弹但尚未挽救整体颓势；另一边则是AI技术加速内卷，但Anthropic推出Opus 5性能逼近Fable且价格减半的新闻，暗示科技与影视的融合正在带来成本与效率的颠覆。人文层面，学者陈先义撰文呼吁中国影视摆脱“明星中心制”，引发行业对内容生产模式的反思。王一博因赛车活动安保升级被车评人批评，官方澄清系合规要求，但粉丝与质疑者的对立明显。
- [猫眼娱乐料半年转蚀最多5500万元，票房下滑四成](https://news.google.)
- [陈先义：中国影视必须摆脱“明星中心制”桎梏](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE1JUjZaLXBmLXFVaGE4MjY2M0lSVkdWd2tIN19ONHdvVF9CN0ZlS1NhcU1nNmRra0pZRmFROW50aDJSa1haRTluelVKQmNMaGNsZmFHLUF5UG1ydEpvUTF1cHlTT1dVYmx3VEU1X0Z1TkFNVC1X)
- [王一博被车评人酸“耍官威”，粉丝出征护主](https://news.google.)

中国娱乐行业在资本退潮与内容转型的阵痛中，市场信心亟需优质作品提振。
中国.en:
Chinese entertainment is grappling with market contraction and a call to shift away from 'star-centered' production. Maoyan's expected loss of up to 55M yuan in the first half reflects a 40% drop in box office, though summer is showing tentative recovery. Meanwhile, actor Wang Yibo faced backlash over an alleged power trip at a racing event, and the industry sees a grassroots push to revive traditional opera through film and TV.

- **Market Downturn**: Maoyan Entertainment expects a net loss of up to 55M yuan for H1 2026, citing a 40% drop in China's film box office, though the summer season is rebounding [星島頭條](https://news.google.).
- **Wang Yibo Controversy**: The actor was accused of displaying 'official arrogance' at a China GT event; his fans retaliated online while he remained silent [世界新聞網](https://news.google.).
- **Traditional Opera Revival**: A trend of integrating opera into film and TV is gaining traction, described as a 'bidirectional empowerment' cycle [shobserver.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTFA4eGRrMWRUUXhFejZ4cmpFMGFtVDVlLVhSRWdPRWt0WnFwZ3JTVllteXFzMTU1OXE4OG92eWJxTnRsN0RkdW0taUpzYkxVQXR2WlJfUEFTSzJqWFVh).
- **New Interactive Drama**: '绍宋：还我河山' (Shao Song: Restore the River and Mountain) is set for release on August 20, blending interactive video and historical themes [中国网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTFBERG5nbjJLMVE4dWp1TklEZ21uVU5NOWh3cWd6QjJCQkdKZ2RsaENNbTR6bFB3VkZvTWk1Y0FuZnY3dXdNbUJfM3FlU1FFV3FnZFk2QkpiSFE2YkxDSWJyWlgwNkxzLS1P).

Monitor the box office recovery trend and Wang Yibo's next moves as they will influence the broader Chinese entertainment economy.

微博社区动态.zh:
微博社区继续展现出粉丝生态的活跃与敏感。因《莲花楼》与《长相思》三周年话题重新被翻出，网友对比两剧在播期热搜数量，认为《莲花楼》依靠口碑而非营销获得了更长尾生命，这一讨论直接指向流量时代内容价值的衡量标准。林依轮以一袭红衣复刻任嘉伦《周生如故》造型，被部分网友批评“蹭热度”，相关话题登上热搜。同时，白鹿与任嘉伦的CP热搜词条被指刻意只提及白鹿，再次引发饭圈对宣发策略的质疑。周震南因微博账号疑似丢失后重新回归，也吸引了大量关注。
- [《莲花楼》与《长相思》热搜对比引发内容价值讨论](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9scTJNOFNyaHdDanoxVUJaM2drMFhWR2VNNEtOdFJleUxreXRuNXhQTVdJYlNBM3ZmamlpU3NUdnJEc2lnUlFBTl9yRkJjVXA4RDZyLTh6T0ctamJCLWVqczB1QQ)
- [林依轮红衣喊话任嘉伦，复刻造型引爆热搜争议](https://news.google.)
- [网友质疑热搜只提白鹿不提任嘉伦](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxQcFpIbnYyTDJtRUJQMVJUMXc3RFlXeDU2MDc3RzVub1B5TmdsaHUwSHNydjE0cFJHcmN3MkI3OXFZTWZmcUxYaEVYUFYyOVJEV2tKc1Z3MHQzZVJOUV9DM1QyWXk5NEZfcjA0d1A4Z2N5QmY5Z3pxbXFIV3ktN0RScDFFYURaeVJCdzRjS0Z2NHJfeWxBalBTY0duYjkyLUlUMFU2Y1Z5OThoZw)
- [周震南痛失微博名，再度回归引热议](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxNMzJ1TWlLWEJpSEhweWZyczhTYjFMeHN6eTIwOTFzMXNucWNqRGdiTDBuYnJMZi0yTkIxRWp4VnFrbFNVR3dZUkdyWTFPcE1rV0ZjSVJPM1RjZ2FWVVZjTW0wN0pnVGJId1lEOTduY3dUQ09lVG1jQmNzX1Y4ZHVpbHVBQ3FQR3Q1NzZXVks5WW4zWlJjMkpkRHluNXhsQzF0WHc)

社区讨论本质上是对“流量与作品”“个人与团队”权重之争的持续映射，后续类似争议仍会频发。
微博社区动态.en:
Weibo is ablaze with fan debates and celebrity gossip. A standout discussion compares the marketing strategies of 'The Lotus Casebook' and 'The Legend of Shen Li' three years post-air, arguing that organic quality outperforms bought traffic. Meanwhile, Zhou Zhennan's return after 'losing' his Weibo name and Lin Yilun's viral costume imitation of Ren Jialun have sparked major trends.

- **Fan Analysis of Marketing vs. Longevity**: A viral post argues that 'The Lotus Casebook' achieved long-lasting popularity because it relied less on bought hot searches compared to 'The Legend of Shen Li', sparking heated discussion [新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9scTJNOFNyaHdDanoxVUJaM2drMFhWR2VNNEtOdFJleUxreXRuNXhQTVdJYlNBM3ZmamlpU3NUdnJEc2lnUlFBTl9yRkJjVXA4RDZyLTh6T0ctamJCLWVqczB1QQ).
